raw.excerpt: What's the role? As a Sales Solution Architect, you will be the technical bridge between our customers, Sales and HERE's technology organization.
raw.description:
What's the role?

As a Sales Solution Architect, you will be the technical bridge between our customers, Sales and HERE's technology organization. You will uncover complex business and technical needs, design solutions using HERE data and platform capabilities, and show customers how location intelligence can create measurable value.

You will lead architecture discussions, demonstrations, workshops and proofs of concept across mapping, routing, APIs, spatial analytics, cloud, AI and enterprise integration. Your goal is to move customers from 'What problem are we solving?' to 'How can HERE solve it?'

What will you do?

  • Lead technical discovery with business, executive, and engineering stakeholders.
  • Design end-to-end solutions using HERE data, APIs, mapping, routing, location services, and platform capabilities.
  • Deliver technical demonstrations, architecture workshops, proofs of concept and evaluations.
  • Partner with Sales to qualify opportunities, reduce technical risk, and accelerate customer decisions.
  • Create solution architectures, proposals, reference designs and reusable presales assets.
  • Work across Product, Engineering, Professional Services and partners to shape viable customer solutions.
  • Apply GIS, spatial analytics, AI and emerging location technologies to real customer problems.
  • Act as a trusted technical advisor throughout the customer journey.

Who are you?

You combine technical depth, commercial judgment, and strong customer engagement. You can simplify complex technology without losing credibility and connect architecture decisions to business outcomes.

  • 5+ years in solution architecture, technical presales, consulting, systems integration or a similar customer-facing technical role.
  • Experience translating complex business requirements into scalable technical solutions.
  • Hands-on experience with APIs, cloud platforms, data architectures, software integration or enterprise technology.
  • Experience creating architectures, technical presentations, demonstrations and proofs of concept.
  • Strong communication skills with developers, architects, business leaders and executives.
  • A consultative mindset and the ability to influence decisions and build trusted relationships.
  • Ability to learn complex platforms quickly and work effectively across Sales, Product and Engineering.

It would be great if you also bring

  • Experience with GIS, mapping, spatial analytics or location intelligence.
  • Domain knowledge in mobility, automotive, transportation, logistics, fleet, supply chain or related industries.
  • Experience with AWS, Microsoft Azure or Google Cloud.
  • Exposure to geospatial AI, digital twins, large-scale data or machine-learning solutions.

Why HERE?

HERE combines global location data, enterprise-grade technology and deep real-world context. You will help customers use those capabilities to optimize movement, improve operations, build location-aware products and apply AI to problems in the physical world. You do not need to know everything about HERE on day one. What matters is your ability to learn quickly, architect credible solutions and communicate their value.

The expected base salary range for this position is $121,000 to $173,000 per year. Actual compensation will be based on factors such as skills and experience. This position is also eligible for an annual performance bonus, which is subject to company and individual performance.

Life at HERE comes with generous benefits to support your health and overall wellness. Benefits available to US-based HERE employees include health (Medical/Dental/Vision) insurance, retirement savings plans, paid time off & leave policies.

As part of HERE Technologies employment process, candidates will be required to successfully complete a background verification process. Offers of employment and any related claims are subject to the successful completion of a background verification. Pursuant to the San Francisco Fair Chance Ordinance and the Los Angeles Fair Chance Initiative for Hiring, HERE will consider for employment qualified applicants with arrest and conviction records.

HERE is an equal opportunity employer. We evaluate qualified applicants without regard to race, color, age, gender identity, sexual orientation, marital status, parental status, religion, sex, national origin, disability, veteran status, and other legally protected characteristics.

Under Section 503 of the Rehabilitation Act of 1973 and VEVRAA, we have developed an affirmative action program (AAP) for individuals with disabilities and protected veterans. Portions of the AAP are available for review by applicants and employees through our People Team.

Who are we?

HERE Technologies is a location data and technology platform company. We empower our customers to achieve better outcomes – from helping a city manage its infrastructure or a business optimize its assets to guiding drivers to their destination safely.

At HERE we take it upon ourselves to be the change we wish to see. We create solutions that fuel innovation, provide opportunity and foster inclusion to improve people’s lives. If you are inspired by an open world and driven to create positive change, join us. Learn more about us. Watch Video

raw.description:
Position Summary

The Transactional Commercial Surety Underwriter is responsible for underwriting, pricing, and managing a portfolio of transactional surety business across a broad range of bond types nationwide. This role partners closely with agents and brokers to drive new business growth, maintain profitability, and deliver exceptional service standards in a fast-paced, high-volume environment.

Key Responsibilities

Underwriting & Risk Assessment

  • Evaluate and underwrite transactional commercial surety submissions, including but not limited to motor vehicle dealer (MVD), license & permit, subdivision, court, contract-related transactional, mortgage broker, and specialty bonds.
  • Analyze financial statements, credit reports, and supporting documentation to assess risk and determine appropriate terms, conditions, and pricing.
  • Apply underwriting authority to approve, decline, or modify submissions in alignment with company guidelines and risk appetite.
  • Ensure compliance with internal underwriting standards, regulatory requirements, and state-specific bond obligations.

Production & Portfolio Management

  • Manage a high volume of transactional submissions while maintaining strong turnaround times and service levels.
  • Monitor and manage a book of business to ensure profitability, retention, and appropriate risk diversification.
  • Identify opportunities for cross-selling and account expansion within existing agency relationships.

Agent/Broker Relationship Management

  • Build and maintain strong relationships with agency partners to drive submission flow and grow market share.
  • Communicate underwriting decisions effectively, including providing clear rationale and alternative solutions when appropriate.
  • Negotiate terms, pricing, and commission structures to remain competitive while maintaining underwriting discipline.
  • Act as a market-facing representative to support agency growth and retention initiatives.

Business Development

  • Support new business development efforts by identifying target agencies and producers within the transactional surety space.
  • Participate in agency visits, industry events, and networking opportunities to strengthen relationships and increase brand presence.
  • Collaborate with leadership to execute strategic growth initiatives within the transactional surety segment.

Operational Excellence

  • Maintain accurate documentation and records within underwriting systems.
  • Ensure timely issuance of bonds, endorsements, renewals, and cancellations.
  • Partner with internal teams (claims, legal, compliance, operations) as needed to support business objectives.

Qualifications & Experience

  • 2+ years of experience in commercial surety underwriting, with a focus on transactional business required
  • Established relationships within the surety agency/broker community required
  • Proven experience underwriting a broad range of bond types (e.g., MVD, subdivision, license & permit, court, contractor-related transactional, specialty bonds)
  • Strong understanding of credit analysis, risk assessment, and financial statement review
  • Demonstrated ability to manage high submission volume while maintaining underwriting discipline
  • Experience negotiating terms, pricing, and commissions in a competitive marketplace
  • Knowledge of state-specific bonding requirements and regulatory environment preferred

Skills & Competencies

  • Strong analytical and decision-making skills
  • Excellent communication and negotiation abilities
  • Relationship-driven, with a strong customer-service orientation
  • Ability to work independently in a fast-paced environment
  • High attention to detail and organizational skills
  • Results-oriented mindset with a focus on growth and profitability

Compensation & Benefits

The applicable base salary for this opportunity is $100,000 - $125,000. The base pay offered will be determined by factors such as experience, skills, training, location, certifications, education, and any applicable minimum wage requirements. In addition to the base salary, this opportunity may be eligible for performance-based incentives.​ We are excited to offer a competitive total rewards package which includes health and welfare benefits, tuition and professional certification assistance, 401k savings, elective participation in the Employee Stock Purchase Program, paid time off, paid holidays, and child bonding leave, as well as other employee assistance.

Encamp’s mission is to make what’s good for business good for the environment. Today, over 200 enterprise organizations trust Encamp to safeguard 40,000+ facilities. We’re helping companies do what’s right for the environment and enabling first responders to navigate emergency situations.

About the role

As an Environmental Data Manager at Encamp, you will be responsible for taming our customer’s complex environmental data. You’ll support our customers through successful implementation by scoping and creating a repeatable process to transform and import customer data into the Encamp Intelligence Platform. EDMs are vital - they ensure our customer has a sturdy and accurate foundation rooted in clean and accurate data to support their journey to build value with Encamp.

What you'll do

  • Scope and manage the implementation of our customers’ data by coordinating with our Engineering team
  • Ensuring functional and accurate data pipelines by providing SME support, QAing data pipeline work, and escalating issues while communicating priorities to Engineering
  • Fulfills customer bespoke reporting obligations

Qualifications

Perks of being part of the Encampus...

Ready to join us around the campfire?

Come join a team of trailblazers making a BIG difference in the environmental programs for more than 20k facilities around the United States. We're on a mission to create a world where good for business is good for the environment.

At Encamp, we believe we are better together – all of us, whatever our race, ethnicity, sexual orientation, age or physical ability. We strive to create an environment that encourages and celebrates diverse voices, backgrounds, and experiences. A cornerstone of our culture is the ability to bring their full, authentic selves to work every day. Encamp is committed to unbiased hiring practices and achieving minority representation above community averages.

In transparency, the base salary for this position is $90,000- $100,000/yr.

description: At EQT, you won't just do a job, you'll help shape our future.

raw.title: Trader I/II/Sr./Principal
raw.excerpt: At EQT, you won't just do a job, you'll help shape our future.
raw.description:
At EQT, you won't just do a job, you'll help shape our future. Through Transparent Leadership, you'll work alongside leaders who value collaboration and ensure every voice is heard. Through Connected Impact, you'll see how your work influences critical business decisions and drives value across our operations. Through Supported Growth, you'll have opportunities to expand your skills through cross-functional collaboration, development opportunities, and career advancement. Join our Qrew!

The Trader I/II/Sr./Principal is responsible for managing and optimizing a natural gas trading portfolio with a focus on US East market, leveraging detailed market analysis, risk management, and execution of physical and financial transactions. The position requires deep knowledge of US East supply/demand dynamics, pipeline flows, and pricing hubs, along with strong quantitative and analytical skills to make disciplined decisions in fast-moving market conditions. The trader partners closely with risk, operations, and commercial teams to drive profitability while adhering to firm risk limits and compliance standards.

 

The Trader I/II/Sr/Principal responsibilities include but are not limited to:

  • Initiate, develop and execute strategies to capture profitable term natural gas trading opportunities within the US East region.
  • Monitor and evaluate relevant market conditions, pivoting in/out of trades as necessitated by market conditions.
  • Evaluate existing trading processes and collaborate with trading personnel to improve efficiency, transparency and value-added measures.
  • Evaluate, execute, and manage short and long-term storage positions across the US East, optimizing around seasonal spreads, and power and industrial load to create incremental value.
  • Use experience to develop optimization and trading strategies and direct origination efforts to execute these strategies.
  • This role is expected to be able to clearly communicate summaries of relevant market conditions & opportunities upward within the organization.
  • Primary responsibility for establishing and executing trading strategies to optimize the value of EQT's contractual pipeline capacity & storage assets.

 

Required Experience and Skills:

  • Bachelor’s degree in accounting, finance, economics, or related field.
  • Minimum of 2 years of experience in natural gas trading, scheduling, and origination.
  • Strong analytical and quantitative skills, strong verbal and written communication skills.
  • Creative/innovative with strong ability to understand market conditions and then translate into profitable results.
  • Knowledge and understanding of regional pipeline/storage infrastructure and respective supply and demand composition and working relationships with commercial participants.
  • Ability to construct a regional supply & demand model, knowledge of specific pipeline constraints, flows, costs, storage, contracts, end users and scheduling.
  • Experience trading physical, futures, swaps, options, storage, index and spreads.
  • Ability to meaningfully contribute to the development of natural gas commercial strategies.
  • Working relationship with commercial participants (producers/pipelines/utilities/end users/traders).
  • Understanding of the calculation of intrinsic & extrinsic values of transportation capacity and storage opportunities.
  • Ability to travel up to 10-20% of the time for customer events, industry conferences, and team gatherings.

 

Preferred Experience and Skills:

  • 5+ years of experience in natural gas trading, scheduling, and origination.
  • Masters degree in business, finance, engineering, or related field.

Remote work is being considered for this role excluding the following states: California, Connecticut, Delaware, Illinois, Indiana, Louisiana, Massachusetts, Michigan, New Jersey, New York, and Tennessee unless willing to relocate.

Selected incumbent will be placed into the position that best suits their abilities and experience level.

EQT Corporation and its subsidiaries is an Equal Opportunity Employer -- Disabilities/Veterans.

External Wholesaler - Retail Sales – Dallas / Fort Worth (TX) Territory

New York Life Investments is seeking a dynamic and results-driven External Wholesaler to represent our investment solutions—including mutual funds, separately managed accounts (SMAs), and ETFs—to financial advisors across Dallas / Fort Worth, Texas area. This individual will work with both wirehouse and independent broker-dealer channels, serving as a trusted resource and strategic partner to financial professionals in the region.

  • Manage a travel and entertainment budget responsibly and within assigned guidelines.
  • Travel frequently—50% or more—to build and maintain advisor relationships and drive business growth across Dallas / Fort Worth, Texas area.

What You’ll Bring:

  • Active FINRA Series 7 and 63 licenses (required).
  • Bachelor’s degree in Finance, Business, or a related field (preferred).
  • Must reside within the required territory.
  • Minimum 5 years of asset management sales experience or financial advisor experience, ideally within the assigned territory.
  • Demonstrated success in meeting or exceeding sales targets and building long-term advisor relationships.
  • Deep knowledge of investment products, including mutual funds, ETFs, SMAs, and capital markets.
  • Excellent communication and presentation skills, with the ability to build credibility and rapport with advisors at all levels.
  • Passion for financial markets and ongoing learning.
  • Natural curiosity with the ability to ask thoughtful questions and uncover advisor needs.

Bright Vision Technologies is a technology consulting and software development company delivering cloud, AI, data, and enterprise solutions across the United States. This is a fantastic opportunity to join an established and well-respected organization offering tremendous career growth potential.

Job Title

Lead Software Architect

Location: 100% Remote (U.S.)
Position Type: Full-time, Direct W2
Salary Range: $175,000–$200,000 Annually
Experience Required:10+ Years

Sponsorship: U.S. Citizens, Green Card Holders, EAD Holders, and H-1B transfer candidates are encouraged to apply. We are unable to sponsor new H-1B visa petitions for this position.

Job Summary

We are seeking a highly accomplished Lead Software Architect with 10+ years of professional software engineering experience to lead enterprise-wide architecture initiatives, define long-term technology strategy, and deliver highly scalable, resilient, and secure distributed systems. This role represents one of the highest levels of individual technical contribution within the organization, requiring deep expertise in software architecture, cloud-native technologies, distributed systems, performance engineering, and technical leadership. The ideal candidate will influence engineering strategy across multiple organizations, establish architectural standards, mentor senior engineers, and drive the successful delivery of mission-critical platforms.

Key Responsibilities

  • Define and drive enterprise software architecture strategy across multiple products, platforms, and engineering organizations.
  • Design highly scalable, fault-tolerant, cloud-native distributed systems capable of supporting enterprise-scale workloads.
  • Establish architecture principles, technical standards, and governance practices that improve software quality and consistency.
  • Lead architecture reviews, technical design sessions, and engineering decision-making for high-impact initiatives.
  • Partner with executive leadership, engineering managers, product teams, and business stakeholders to align technology strategy with organizational objectives.
  • Drive platform modernization initiatives, including microservices adoption, cloud migration, API strategy, and event-driven architectures.
  • Lead performance optimization, scalability planning, reliability engineering, and system resiliency improvements.
  • Mentor Staff and Senior Engineers while fostering engineering excellence, architectural best practices, and technical innovation.
  • Evaluate emerging technologies and recommend strategic investments that improve engineering capabilities and business outcomes.
  • Author and review architecture documentation, technical RFCs, design specifications, and Architecture Decision Records (ADRs).
  • Contribute hands-on to critical architectural components, proof-of-concepts, and complex technical implementations when appropriate.
  • Champion DevSecOps, observability, automation, and operational excellence across engineering teams.

Required Qualifications

  • Bachelor's or Master's degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, or a related technical discipline.
  • 10+ years of professional software engineering experience, including significant experience designing and delivering enterprise-scale software platforms.
  • Proven expertise architecting and deploying large-scale distributed systems in production environments.
  • Advanced programming proficiency in Java, Go, C++, C#, or similar backend technologies.
  • Deep understanding of software architecture, microservices, distributed computing, API design, messaging systems, and event-driven architectures.
  • Strong expertise in cloud platforms such as AWS, Microsoft Azure, or Google Cloud Platform (GCP).
  • Extensive experience with performance engineering, scalability, high availability, disaster recovery, and system optimization.
  • Demonstrated success leading cross-functional technical initiatives spanning multiple engineering teams or business units.
  • Strong understanding of Site Reliability Engineering (SRE), observability, CI/CD, Infrastructure as Code, and modern DevOps practices.
  • Excellent communication, leadership, analytical, and stakeholder management skills.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Public technical contributions, including conference presentations, published papers, technical blogs, patents, or leadership in open-source projects.
  • Experience leading multi-year enterprise modernization or digital transformation programs.
  • Knowledge of FinOps, cloud governance, and large-scale cloud cost optimization strategies.
  • Experience designing solutions for regulated industries such as financial services, healthcare, or government.
  • Advanced degree (Master's or Ph.D.) or recognized industry certifications in software architecture or cloud technologies.
  • Experience with Kubernetes, service mesh technologies, enterprise integration patterns, and AI-enabled software platforms.

Who we are

About Stripe

Stripe is a financial infrastructure platform for businesses. Millions of companies—from the world’s largest enterprises to the most ambitious startups—use Stripe to accept payments, grow their revenue, and accelerate new business opportunities. Our mission is to increase the GDP of the internet, and we have a staggering amount of work ahead. That means you have an unprecedented opportunity to put the global economy within everyone’s reach while doing the most important work of your career.

About the team

The CEE team is a highly consultative sales team that is responsible for the growth of Stripe’s largest customers within the region. We work with some of the most ambitious and fastest-growing companies in the world, including Booksy, Maczfit, and ElevenLabs - Stripe’s payments and financial infrastructure unlocks new revenue streams and growth opportunities for their businesses.

What you’ll do

As an Enterprise Account Executive, you’ll own the full sales cycle, from prospecting and closing to managing existing relationships and identifying new opportunities to expand Stripe’s footprint within existing accounts. Specifically, we’re looking for someone who can execute on long-term sales strategies, engage with internal and external stakeholders, align on technical and business requirements with product teams, build value in competitive situations, lead commercial negotiations, and close deals.

Responsibilities

  • Work with both new and existing Stripe customers to develop and execute long-term sales strategies to expand Stripe’s revenue
  • Own the full sales cycle, from business case development, to deal structuring and negotiating, to close
  • Own a named account list and develop account plans for winning and expanding business with high growth technology companies

raw.description:
We're transforming the grocery industry

At Instacart, we invite the world to share love through food because we believe everyone should have access to the food they love and more time to enjoy it together. Where others see a simple need for grocery delivery, we see exciting complexity and endless opportunity to serve the varied needs of our community. We work to deliver an essential service that customers rely on to get their groceries and household goods, while also offering safe and flexible earnings opportunities to Instacart Personal Shoppers.

Instacart has become a lifeline for millions of people, and we’re building the team to help push our shopping cart forward. If you’re ready to do the best work of your life, come join our table.

Instacart is a Flex First team

There’s no one-size fits all approach to how we do our best work. Our employees have the flexibility to choose where they do their best work—whether it’s from home, an office, or your favorite coffee shop—while staying connected and building community through regular in-person events. Learn more about our flexible approach to where we work.

Overview

Instacart's Enterprise Solutions team partners with North America's largest grocery and retail chains to power their digital commerce through StorefrontPro, the Enterprise API (Fulfillment and Ads), CarrotAds, and adjacent software products. We're seeking a Director, Customer Success to lead the commercial Retailer Success organization — accountable for post-live growth, retention, and expansion across the enterprise software portfolio.

In this highly visible role, you will lead a team of senior managers, Account Growth Managers (AGMs), and L7 Principal Growth Strategists who serve as the strategic and commercial face of Instacart to retailer executives. You'll own the outcomes that matter: net revenue retention (NRR), gross revenue retention (GRR), expansion GTV, adoption velocity, and CSAT. You'll partner closely with Business Development on commercial leadership, with the Sr Director on portfolio-level strategy, with the Director of Enterprise Architecture & Engineering (the technical CS / PSM function) on shared accounts, and with Product on retailer signal and roadmap adoption.

This is a roll-up-your-sleeves leadership opportunity for someone who has personally led the transformation of CS from reactive enablement toward proactive business advisory, can hire and develop senior consultative talent, and thrives in a fast-paced, BD-led commercial environment with shared standards rather than rigid process. The role reports to the Senior Director, Enterprise Delivery and Growth, and is remote across the United States and Canada with a preference for proximity to Toronto for key cross-functional collaboration.

About the Job

  • Lead the Retailer Success organization for the enterprise software portfolio — owning commercial CS outcomes end to end, including NRR, GRR, expansion GTV, adoption velocity, CSAT, and renewal performance.
  • Build and develop a senior consultative CS bench by hiring, sponsoring, and ramping L7 Principal Growth Strategists who engage retailer executives on ecommerce strategy, merchandising, and operations — not platform configuration — and who can credibly influence retailer P&L outcomes and roadmap adoption.
  • Manage senior managers leading AGM (Account Growth Manager) pods, setting standards for what good looks like across the L7, AGM, and account team layers — including QBR quality, growth planning, executive engagement, and renewal execution.
  • Operate in a BD-led commercial environment as a true commercial peer to BD — preserving BD's ownership of the primary commercial relationship while owning post-sale accountability and surfacing churn, expansion, and escalation signal early and clearly.
  • Partner with the Director of Enterprise Architecture & Engineering on shared-account coordination — ensuring the cross-org account team (commercial CS + technical CS / PSM) functions as one team to the retailer despite the org split, with co-authored protocols and clean escalation paths.
  • Define and enforce the L7 boundary: L7s as routers and strategists, not resolvers — ensuring AGMs and PSMs absorb operational and technical execution so L7 capacity remains focused on retailer-executive engagement and growth strategy.
  • Own the consultative transformation roadmap — talent strategy, comp structure, operating cadence, and tooling shifts required to evolve CS from a feature-enablement function into a strategic business advisory function for Tier A and B accounts.
  • Partner with the Director of Retailer Delivery on the implementation-to-success motion as a managed lifecycle (not a document handoff) — ensuring CS is engaged early, named handoff criteria are met, and accounts transition cleanly into early-lifecycle growth ownership.
  • Operationalize the tier model in CS — applying high-touch (L7 + AGM + PSM) coverage for Tier A/B and scaled/digital-first models for Tier C/D, with clear exception protocols and capacity guardrails.
  • Build a structured retailer-signal feedback loop into Product — using CS engagements to surface durable patterns (not anecdotes), instrument adoption of roadmap items, and hold CS accountable for adoption outcomes.
  • Apply AI augmentation to scale CS coverage and quality without linear headcount growth — including health monitoring, account-prep automation, QBR/insight generation, and signal triage — partnering with the Technical org on tooling roadmap and adoption.
  • Represent the post-sale narrative for the portfolio to senior leadership — integrating retention, growth, churn risk, executive-account temperature, and pipeline outlook — and serve as the Director-level escalation point for retailer relationships when AGM-led engagement is insufficient.

About You

Minimum Qualifications

  • 8+ years of enterprise customer success, account management, or post-sale leadership at a B2B SaaS or enterprise technology company.
  • Direct, accountable leadership of a customer success organization responsible for post-live growth, NRR, and expansion — owning the number, not just contributing to it.
  • Track record of managing managers (M2/Senior Manager layer), with demonstrated ability to set standards and develop senior leaders without micromanagement.
  • Ownership of a CS book or post-sale P&L of meaningful scale (e.g., $50M+ ARR) with documented outcomes on NRR, GRR, or expansion.
  • Proven success operating in a BD- or Sales-led commercial environment — clear instinct for where the CS lane begins and ends, comfort with shared standards rather than rigid RACI/process.
  • Demonstrated executive presence with enterprise customer counterparts (VP / SVP / C-level), including the ability to deliver hard news, navigate escalations, and rebuild trust after issues.
  • Experience designing and operating tiered CS coverage models (high-touch for strategic accounts, scaled/digital for the long tail), including capacity planning and exception handling.
  • Hands-on experience hiring senior consultative talent — Principal CS, Strategy, or equivalent — with a clear point of view on profile, comp, and ramp.
  • Strong working knowledge of the implementation-to-success seam — how delivery and CS hand off (or, ideally, run in parallel) on the same accounts, and what breaks when they don't.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience transforming a CS function from reactive enablement into proactive business advisory, including the talent, comp, operating-model, and tooling changes required (not a renaming exercise).
  • Track record of building or scaling Principal-level / strategist roles inside a CS org — including hiring profile, ramp, comp design, and integration with the rest of the account team.
  • Experience operating with a separate technical CS / PSM / TAM function on shared enterprise accounts — including co-authoring cross-org protocols and managing escalations across an org boundary.
  • Background applying AI to CS workflows — health monitoring, account preparation, QBR generation, signal triage — with measurable impact on coverage, throughput, or quality.
  • Familiarity with the BD/CS interface in commercially complex enterprise sales motions, including renewals, multi-product expansion, and shared-account operating norms.
  • Deep familiarity with enterprise retail, grocery, ecommerce platforms, retail media, or adjacent complex B2B domains — including how large retailers evaluate, adopt, and scale technology solutions.
  • Experience instrumenting retailer signal into structured product feedback (not anecdotal) and partnering with Product leaders on adoption accountability.

  • Deeply understand the bi-directional technical and commercial relationship between Asana's product suite and Amazon's infrastructure/marketplace.
  • Build and scale trusted partnerships with Fortune 10 senior line-of-business and IT executives across Amazon.
  • Design and execute high-impact Quarterly Business Reviews (QBRs) that clearly quantify and prove Asana's value realization.
  • Generate awareness and early adoption of Asana’s latest innovation portfolio, including AI Teammates, Dash, and agentic AI workflows.
  • Collaborate closely with Asana's channel and partner teams to optimize our presence and co-selling opportunities via the Amazon Web Services (AWS) Marketplace.
  • Proactively construct the commercial runway and strategic roadmap for a massive upcoming renewal cycle.

About you

  • Demonstrates curiosity about AI tools and emerging technologies, with a willingness to learn and leverage them to enhance productivity, collaboration, or decision-making.
  • Proven experience managing a single named strategic account of massive scale - ideally Amazon directly, or a comparable Fortune 10 enterprise where the account represented a top-three revenue relationship for your company.
  • 10+ years of experience in enterprise software sales, with 6+ years specifically selling in the Enterprise or Strategic segment.
  • Demonstrated ability to negotiate and drive massive, multi-million dollar renewal cycles end-to-end, leveraging executive alignment and strategic account planning.
  • Natural capability to act as the "quarterback" for a dedicated account team, aligning Product, Engineering, Customer Success, and Partner/Channel teams to serve the customer.
  • Outstanding instincts for mapping and navigating complex organizational, political, and financial structures within decentralized enterprise environments.
  • Direct existing relationships within Amazon's IT, Collaboration, or major Line of Business functions (e.g., Marketing, Sales, Product, HR) is a plus.
  • Prior experience navigating SaaS co-selling and purchasing via the AWS Marketplace is a plus.

At Asana, we're committed to building teams that include a variety of backgrounds, perspectives, and skills, as this is critical to helping us achieve our mission. If you're interested in this role and don't meet every listed requirement, we still encourage you to apply.

What we’ll offer

Our comprehensive compensation package plays a big part in how we recognize you for the impact you have on our path to achieving our mission. We believe that compensation should be reflective of the value you create relative to the market value of your role. To ensure pay is fair and not impacted by biases, we're committed to looking at market value which is why we check ourselves and conduct a yearly pay equity audit.

For this role, the estimated On-Target Earnings (OTE) range for this role will be $355,000 – $380,000 OTE which includes a base salary range of $177,500 – $190,000 and performance-based sales incentive pay (based on the terms of the Sales Incentive Plan). These ranges are a guideline; actual base salary and OTE may vary based on various factors, including market and individual qualifications objectively assessed during the interview process, and the ranges for this role may be modified.

We strive to provide equitable and competitive benefits packages that support our employees worldwide and include:

  • Mental health, wellness & fitness benefits

  • Career coaching & support

  • Inclusive family building benefits

  • Long-term savings or retirement plans

  • In-office culinary options to cater to your dietary preferences

These are just some of the benefits we offer, and benefits may vary based on role, country, and local regulations. If you're interviewing for this role, speak with your recruiter to learn more about the total compensation and benefits for this role.

About us

Asana is a leading platform for human + AI collaboration. Millions of teams around the world rely on Asana to achieve their most important goals, faster. raw.title: Senior Staff Product Manager, Browser Control Platform
raw.excerpt: Why Mozilla? Mozilla Corporation is the non-profit-backed technology company that has shaped the internet for the better over the last 25 years.
raw.description:
Why Mozilla?

Mozilla Corporation is the non-profit-backed technology company that has shaped the internet for the better over the last 25 years. We make pioneering brands like Firefox, the privacy-minded web browser. Now, with more than 225 million people around the world using our products each month, we’re shaping the next 25 years of technology and helping to reclaim an internet built for people, not companies. Our work focuses on diverse areas including AI, social media, security and more. And we’re doing this while never losing our focus on our core mission – to make the internet better for people.

The Mozilla Corporation is wholly owned by the non-profit 501(c) Mozilla Foundation. This means we aren’t beholden to any shareholders — only to our mission. Along with thousands of volunteer contributors and collaborators all over the world, Mozillians design, build and distribute open-source software that enables people to enjoy the internet on their terms.

About this team and role:

This role owns the foundation that lets other software drive Firefox: the secure, reliable connection an outside tool or another team uses to act inside the browser, and the building blocks they call to do it. It enables the teams building on it — internal teams, outside AI tools — to create their own products on top. This role owns the shared layer and the strategy for it. It’s a hands-on, technical role in a fast-moving, greenfield space, so it’s as much strategy as execution.

The opportunity is broad: internal teams (Smart Window, New Products’ automated tools), outside AI tools and their users, and web developers. The three share much of the underlying technology, but each reaches its market in a different way. The mandate is to figure out what to go after, and in what order.

What you’ll do:
  • Own the shared foundation and the building blocks it gives other software, and make them reliable and secure.
  • Push the open standard (WebDriver BiDi) forward, and build Firefox-only advantages the standard won’t cover
  • Design the safety controls: let a person approve actions, see when software is acting for them, and take back control.
  • Define the strategy for any major third-party AI assistants people already use.
  • Serve internal teams (Smart Window, New Products) and outside tools through one shared layer.
Measured on:

Adoption across teams and tools, volume of usage through the platform, and sustained reliability and security.

What you'll bring:
  • A product-minded engineer, or a very technical PM who can drive a technical product
  • Developer-space experience, with the range to think about consumers and internal platforms
  • Comfortable setting strategy in ambiguity; own a technical contract other teams depend on
  • Strong instincts on security and trust. Nice to have: web standards, MCP, browser automation

What you’ll get:

  • Generous performance-based bonus plans to all eligible employees - we share in our success as one team
  • Rich medical, dental, and vision coverage
  • Generous retirement contributions with 100% immediate vesting (regardless of whether you contribute)
  • Quarterly all-company wellness days where everyone takes a pause together
  • Country specific holidays plus a day off for your birthday
  • One-time home office stipend
  • Annual professional development budget
  • Quarterly well-being stipend
  • Considerable paid parental leave
  • Employee referral bonus program
  • Other benefits (life/AD&D, disability, EAP, etc. - varies by country)

About Mozilla

Mozilla exists to build the Internet as a public resource accessible to all because we believe that open and free is better than closed and controlled. When you work at Mozilla, you give yourself a chance to make a difference in the lives of Web users everywhere. And you give us a chance to make a difference in your life every single day. Join us to work on the Web as the platform and help create more opportunity and innovation for everyone online.

Commitment to diversity, equity, inclusion, and belonging

Mozilla understands that valuing diverse creative practices and forms of knowledge are crucial to and enrich the company’s core mission. We encourage applications from everyone, including members of all equity-seeking communities, such as (but certainly not limited to) women, racialized and Indigenous persons, persons with disabilities, persons of all sexual orientations, gender identities, and expressions.

We will ensure that qualified individuals with disabilities are provided reasonable accommodations to participate in the job application or interview process, to perform essential job functions, and to receive other benefits and privileges of employment, as appropriate. Please contact us at to request accommodation.

We are an equal opportunity employer. We do not discriminate on the basis of race (including hairstyle and texture), religion (including religious grooming and dress practices), gender, gender identity, gender expression, color, national origin, pregnancy, ancestry, domestic partner status, disability, sexual orientation, age, genetic predisposition, medical condition, marital status, citizenship status, military or veteran status, or any other basis covered by applicable laws. Mozilla will not tolerate discrimination or harassment based on any of these characteristics or any other unlawful behavior, conduct, or purpose.

title: Outbound Sales Representative
description: We're looking for a confident communicator to join our sales team.

raw.title: Outbound Sales Representative
raw.excerpt: We're looking for a confident communicator to join our sales team.
raw.description:
We're looking for a confident communicator to join our sales team. In this role, you'll introduce our services to marketing executives across the United States, identify potential opportunities, and schedule qualified meetings for our sales team.
Previous cold-calling or B2B sales experience is helpful but not essential. We welcome applications from recent graduates, career changers, and motivated individuals with excellent communication skills.

Key Responsibilities

  • Prospect. Make outbound cold calls to marketing executives and business decision-makers across the United States.
  • Engage. Speak with decision-makers such as Marketing Directors, Marketing Managers, Chief Marketing Officers (CMOs), Digital Marketing Managers, Growth Marketing Managers, Brand Managers, and business owners.
  • Present. Introduce our services in a clear, professional, and conversational manner.
  • Qualify. Build rapport, ask thoughtful qualifying questions, and identify prospective clients who are a good fit for our services.
  • Handle objections. Respond professionally to common questions and objections while maintaining a positive customer experience.
  • Book meetings. Schedule qualified appointments for our sales team and ensure accurate calendar coordination.
  • Maintain records. Keep accurate CRM records, including call outcomes, notes, and follow-up activities.
  • Improve continuously. Participate in call reviews, role-play sessions, and ongoing coaching to strengthen your sales skills.

Skills, Knowledge and Expertise

  • Excellent communication. Clear spoken English that can be easily understood by customers in the United States.
  • Confidence. Comfortable speaking with senior business decision-makers over the phone.
  • Active listening. Able to ask insightful questions and understand customer needs.
  • Coachability. Welcomes feedback and applies it to improve performance.
  • Resilience. Maintains a positive attitude and persistence when facing rejection.
  • Curiosity. Enjoys learning about businesses and uncovering opportunities through conversation.
  • Organisation. Strong attention to detail with the ability to accurately maintain CRM records and follow-up activities.
  • Fast learner. Quickly understands new products, services, and sales techniques.
  • Professionalism. Represents the company with confidence and integrity in every interaction.
  • Natural communication. Able to follow a structured sales process while sounding authentic and conversational, rather than reading mechanically from a script.
Nice to Have
  • Experience. Previous experience in marketing, cold calling, telesales, appointment setting, customer service, or B2B sales is preferred but not required. We believe communication skills, coachability, and a willingness to learn are stronger predictors of success than experience alone.

Benefits

  • Comprehensive training. Learn our products, services, and proven outbound sales process.
  • Ongoing coaching. Receive regular feedback, call reviews, and mentoring to help you succeed.
  • Career development. Build highly transferable communication, negotiation, and business development skills.
  • Remote flexibility. Work remotely with a supportive team.
  • Competitive pay. Earn USD $4–$8 per hour, depending on relevant experience, communication skills, demonstrated sales ability, and overall fit for the role. Bonuses are available for strong performance, including qualified meetings successfully booked.
  • Growth opportunities. This role has the potential to become an ongoing position for the right candidate, with opportunities for growth as you develop your skills and contribute to the team's success.

description: As an Account Executive, you'll independently own the full consultative sales cycle, from discovery and solution design through pricing, negotiation, and close.

raw.title: Account Executive
raw.excerpt: As an Account Executive, you'll independently own the full consultative sales cycle, from discovery and solution design through pricing, negotiation, and close.
raw.description:
As an Account Executive, you'll independently own the full consultative sales cycle, from discovery and solution design through pricing, negotiation, and close. You'll work with executives and senior leaders to understand complex organizational challenges, build the case for change, and show how ClearPoint can help them execute their strategy more effectively. You'll be expected to create momentum, navigate multiple stakeholders, and make sound decisions about how to move opportunities forward.

You'll own a meaningful revenue target and self-sourced pipeline goal while working with municipalities, state agencies, banks, utilities, healthcare organizations, and mid-to-large sized businesses.

We'll provide strong teammates, access to company leadership, and a generous incentive-based compensation plan. You'll bring the judgment, urgency, and accountability needed to consistently turn qualified opportunities into long-term ClearPoint customers.

Responsibilities

  • Independently manage the full sales cycle from discovery through proposal, negotiation, contracting, and close
  • Conduct strategic discovery with executives and key stakeholders to understand organizational priorities, challenges, decision processes, and measures of success
  • Develop and deliver tailored software demonstrations that connect ClearPoint's capabilities to specific customer needs and outcomes
  • Build clear account and opportunity strategies, including stakeholder mapping, competitive positioning, risks, timelines, and next steps
  • Navigate complex buying groups and build relationships with champions, executive sponsors, decision-makers, and procurement teams
  • Own proposals, pricing conversations, and negotiations while protecting the value of ClearPoint's solution
  • Maintain momentum throughout the sales process by establishing clear next steps and addressing deal risk early
  • Generate self-sourced pipeline alongside opportunities provided by BDRs and Marketing
  • Maintain accurate opportunity records, pipeline forecasting, and activity documentation in Salesforce CRM
  • Utilize sales tools including Gong, Salesloft, ZoomInfo, and other systems to support prospecting and opportunity management
  • Achieve monthly, quarterly, and annual sales goals as outlined by sales management
  • Collaborate with BDRs and cross-functional teams including Marketing, Customer Success, Implementation, and Product
  • Provide a thorough handoff to Customer Success and Implementation following close
  • Share market, competitive, and customer feedback with leadership to improve ClearPoint's product and go-to-market strategy
  • Serve as a role model for Junior AEs and BDRs by sharing successful sales strategies, deal lessons, and best practices
  • Represent ClearPoint professionally at client meetings, conferences, webinars, and industry events
Please note this job description is not designed to cover or contain a comprehensive listing of activities, duties or responsibilities that are required of the employee for this job. Duties, responsibilities, and activities may change at any time with or without notice.

Key Result Areas

  • Annualized ARR Closed as per your compensation plan
  • Annualized Services Revenue as per your compensation plan
  • Annualized Self-Sourced Pipeline and/or Revenue as per your compensation plan
  • Overall quota attainment
  • Pipeline coverage and forecast accuracy
  • Consistent opportunity management and CRM discipline

Required Education and Experience

  • 2 to 5 years of consultative B2B sales experience with a demonstrated track record of meeting or exceeding revenue goals
  • Experience independently managing a full sales cycle from discovery through close
  • Experience selling SaaS, software, or another complex business solution preferred
  • Demonstrated ability to build trusted relationships with executives and senior decision-makers
  • Strong discovery, presentation, and communication skills
  • Experience leading pricing and negotiation conversations
  • Ability to prioritize opportunities, develop deal strategy, and make sound commercial decisions independently
  • Strong organizational skills and ability to manage multiple complex opportunities simultaneously
  • Proficiency in CRM management, with Salesforce experience strongly preferred
  • Consistent history of generating pipeline through self-sourced prospecting
  • High-energy, results-oriented approach balanced with strong relationship-building and collaboration
  • Tons of energy, passion, humor, compassion, and enthusiasm
  • Ability to thrive in a fast-paced, dynamic environment and adapt to shifting priorities

Preferred Education and Experience

  • Bachelor's degree or equivalent relevant professional experience
  • Experience carrying a SaaS or enterprise software revenue quota
  • Background in strategy, strategic planning, performance management, or KPI management
  • Experience working with local or state government organizations
  • Experience navigating complex procurement, RFP, legal, or security review processes

Remote Work Expectations

This is a fully remote position for employees residing within 150 miles of Arlington, VA. Account Executives are expected to maintain a professional remote work environment that supports prospect meetings, product demonstrations, outbound activity, and internal collaboration. Employees may occasionally be asked to attend in-person meetings, team events, client meetings, or other business activities within the region. We typically come together as a team or with other teams once per quarter.

Living the ClearPoint Values

  • We hire and promote against our core values. Even at the entry level, you should be able to talk about how you have lived each of them—from school, internships, prior jobs, sports, volunteer work, anywhere:
  • We Care About The Customer. A time you made someone else look like the hero—where they walked away looking smart because of how you showed up.
  • We Play To Win. A time you held yourself accountable for great work and put your best foot forward, even when nobody was watching.
  • We Are Passionate. A time you worked hard, got stuff done, and still made it fun for the people around you.
  • We Are Exceptionally Open. A time you flagged a problem early, asked the awkward question, or surfaced something uncomfortable instead of letting it sit.
  • We Are Welcoming. A time you helped someone with a different background or perspective feel included and able to do their best work.

Who You Are

  • Hungry. You want the work. You want to learn. You want to be good at this.
  • Humble. You ask questions, you take feedback, and you don’t pretend to know things.
  • Comfortable making decisions with incomplete information. You can form a point of view, defend it, and adjust when the facts change.
  • AI-fluent or AI-curious. You already use AI in your day-to-day.
  • A clear communicator. You write well, you listen, and you can explain things well.
  • Organized. You can juggle a portfolio of accounts and prioritize without dropping balls.
  • Curious. You read. You poke at the edges. You want to understand why, not just what.

Base Salary Range

  • $50,000 - $70,000
  • Uncapped commissions
  • Performance-based bonus program

Benefits

  • Competitive salary commensurate with your experience
  • Performance-based bonus program
  • 100% paid health insurance & dental insurance
  • 401(k) program
  • Open vacation policy
  • Professional development, training, and mentorship programs

Why Work for ClearPoint?

  • Chance to get in on the “ground floor” of a tech company with startup energy
  • Ability to make a difference from day one
  • Fantastic colleagues and customers
  • Employee referral bonuses to encourage the addition of great new people to the team
  • Team events and offsite retreats
  • Company organized volunteer days

Eligibility

  • Candidates must live within ~100-150 miles of Arlington, VA and live and work in the following states: VA, DC, MD, PA.
  • Employment is contingent upon successful completion of the I9 Federal work authorization verification. We don't offer visa sponsorship or work permits.
  • Employment is contingent upon successful background and reference checks.

Interested?

Please read this posting carefully, visit our website, learn about us, and then apply. To be considered, please fill out the form and attach your resume. We needed someone yesterday, and we are excited to grow our team, so if you're a good fit, expect this process to move quickly.

Pre-Employment Background Checks

All offers of employment are contingent upon clear results of a thorough background check. Background checks will be conducted on all final candidates and on all employees who are promoted, as deemed necessary and may include: Social Security Verification, Criminal History, Credit History, Personal and Professional References, social media, Prior Employment Verification, Educational Verification, and Motor Vehicle Records. ClearPoint reserves the right to modify this policy at any time without notice.

EEO Statement

ClearPoint Strategy provides equal employment opportunities (EEO) to all employees and applicants without regard to race, color, religion, sex, national origin, sexual orientation, gender identity, age, disability, or genetics. We seek to build a diverse staff representative of the communities we serve. All qualified applicants are strongly encouraged to apply.

Physical Requirements

This is sedentary work requiring typing and other and repetitive motions. Vocal communication is required for expressing or exchanging ideas by means of the spoken word. Hearing is required to perceive information at normal spoken word levels. Visual acuity is required for operation of a computer and for observing general surroundings and activities. The worker is not subject to adverse environmental conditions.

raw.title: UI/UX Designer
raw.excerpt: Your influential mission.  You will... • Design mobile-first iGaming products, with adaptations for desktop and tablet platforms.
raw.description:
Your influential mission. You will...

  • Design mobile-first iGaming products, with adaptations for desktop and tablet platforms.
  • Work with global and local design systems to create UI layouts, interactive components, and game-specific visual flows.
  • Create game assets, logos, illustrations, and support basic motion UI or sprite generation when needed.
  • Collaborate closely with Product Owners, Product Managers, developers, and fellow designers to bring engaging gaming experiences to life.

Components for success. You...

  • Have 1–2+ years of experience in UI/UX design, or a strong portfolio that clearly shows your UI potential.
  • Are confident working in Figma and can use it for UI layouts, design systems, and interactive components.
  • Have strong understanding of mobile-first UI/UX principles, as mobile is the primary platform for this role.
  • Bring a good sense of color balance, typography, composition, and overall visual quality.
  • Can communicate clearly in English and Ukrainian and enjoy working closely with both creative and technical colleagues.
  • Take ownership of your tasks and feel comfortable moving ideas from concept to final delivery.
  • Stay proactive, responsible, and open to feedback while working in a fast-moving product environment.
  • Have a keen eye for details and care about creating polished, high-quality visual experiences.

You'll get extra points for...

  • Previous experience in iGaming or the broader game development industry.
  • Knowledge of Adobe Photoshop and Illustrator for asset creation, illustrations, or prepress tasks.
  • Basic experience with Adobe After Effects for micro-animations or sprite generation.
  • Understanding of Spine or similar tools used in game animation workflows.

Thrive in a culture that values...

  • Designing dynamic iGaming products directly for mobile and desktop platforms, with plenty of room to bring strong visual ideas to life.
  • A collaborative setup with streamlined workflows.
  • Varied games and non-standard tasks that keep the work interesting, encourage creativity, and support out-of-the-box thinking.
  • The ability to use AI tools and innovative design practices where they add real value to the creative process.

HOW TO APPLY?

Please submit your CV together with a portfolio that highlights your UI work, visual design skills, and ideally examples of mobile-first or game-related projects.

LIVE UI/UX DESIGNERS TEAM

Playtech Live is the powerhouse behind our premium real‑time casino product - a unique blend of cutting‑edge technology, interactive design, and entertainment. We’re constantly exploring new visual and technological possibilities, pushing boundaries, and creating world‑class player experiences. If you enjoy crafting products that millions of users interact with daily, you’ll love being part of this team.

Our Live UI/UX Designers team works on mobile-first iGaming products, creating engaging visual experiences across mobile, desktop, and tablet. The team combines global and local design systems, game assets, logos, illustrations, and close collaboration with Product Owners, Product Managers, and developers, making the work varied, creative, and rarely routine.

Playtech is an equal opportunities employer. Our mission is to welcome everyone and create inclusive teams. We celebrate differences and encourage everyone to join us and be themselves at work.

About Playtech

Founded in 1999, the company has a premium listing on the Main Market of the London Stock Exchange and is focused on regulated and regulating markets across its B2B business. By leveraging its proprietary technology, Playtech delivers innovative products and services to ensure a safe, engaging and entertaining gaming experience.

As the gaming industry's leading technology company, it combines business intelligence-driven software, services, content, and platform technology to drive excellence and innovation across the sector. Read more about who we are and what we do here: www.playtechpeople.com and www.playtech.com

Here at Playtech, we genuinely believe that people are our biggest asset. Diverse thoughts, experiences, and individual characteristics enrich our work environment and lead to better business decisions. Embracing differences and maintaining transparency in our processes is the core of Playtech's overall commitment to responsible business practices.

Ready to level up your career?

Playtech‘s Live unit is looking for a proactive UI/UX Designer with strong visual taste, solid UI skills, and a keen eye for gaming experiences.

raw.description:
BeyondTrust is a place where you can bring your purpose to life through the work that you do, creating a safer world through our cyber security SaaS portfolio.

Our culture of flexibility, trust, and continual learning means you will be recognized for your growth, and for the impact you make on our success. You will be surrounded by people who challenge, support, and inspire you to be the best version of yourself.

Please Note: Candidates must be located in the Eastern or Central Timezones in order to be considered.

The Role

The Account Development Representative is responsible for maintaining and developing relationships with existing customers. The role is an overlay to Enterprise Account Managers/Senior Account Executives to assist in creating new revenue opportunities, driving the sales process for add-on opportunities, and helping ensure high levels of customer satisfaction across the territory.

What You’ll Do

  • Support and collaborate with Senior Account Executives and EAMs within their defined region to manage and close both new opportunities and customer add-ons, ensuring seamless communications and transitions for the customer
  • Develop existing accounts within the defined territory and focus account list.
  • Assisting the EAM’s/ Senior Account Executives in maintaining commercial customer relationships and identifying opportunities for growing revenue across customer accounts.
  • Independently managing and closings add-on opportunities for customer accounts in territory.
  • Engages and coordinates with EAM, SAE, (i)SE, CSM, Renewals team, and other POD members on territory strategy.
  • Be highly responsive to prospects and customers, providing them with the information they need throughout the sales process
  • Maintain accurate and complete account data in Salesforce
  • Provide accurate and timely opportunity updates and bookings forecasts
  • Co-own sales achievement goals against a specified territory and team quota
  • Maintain awareness of market conditions and competitors' products and pricing and keep up to date on knowledge of the company

What You’ll Bring

  • Bachelor’s degree, or relevant work experience
  • 1-2 years successful track record in sales development and or sales (technology, software, B2B, etc.)
  • Ability to work under pressure and meet deadlines
  • Ability to communicate complex technology and value propositions
  • Independent, yet a team player
  • Motivation to expand personal and professional knowledge of product and sales skills
  • Strategic outlook
  • Above average organizational, planning, communication, and problem-solving skills
  • Strong presentation and critical thinking skills
  • Excellent written and verbal communications

Nice To Have

  • Experience with Salesforce strongly preferred
  • Ability to manage multiple concurrent sales cycles
  • Security, SaaS sales experience
  • Familiarity with technology and cybersecurity

Better Together

Diversity. Inclusion. They’re more than just words for us. They are the guiding values of how we build our teams, cultivate leaders, and create a culture where people feel connected.

We take care of our employees so they can take care of our customers. Customers who come from all walks of life just like us. We hire incredible people from diverse backgrounds because when we are different together, we are stronger together.

About Us

BeyondTrust is the global identity security leader protecting Paths to Privilege™. Our identity-centric approach goes beyond securing privileges and access, empowering organizations with the most effective solution to manage the entire identity attack surface and neutralize threats, whether from external attacks or insiders.

BeyondTrust is leading the charge in transforming identity security to prevent breaches and limit the blast radius of attacks, while creating a superior customer experience and operational efficiencies. We are trusted by 20,000 customers, including 75 of the Fortune 100, and our global ecosystem of partners.

The CDI Specialist facilitates and obtains appropriate physician documentation for any patient clinical condition or procedure to support the appropriate severity of illness, expected risk of mortality, and complexity of care as documented in patient medical records. Extensive medical record review and interaction with physicians, nursing staff, other patient care givers and HIM coding professionals is done to ensure the documentation is complete and accurate.

About Summit:

Summit Therapeutics Inc. is a biopharmaceutical oncology company with a mission focused on improving quality of life, increasing potential duration of life, and resolving serious unmet medical needs. At Summit, we believe in building a team of world class professionals who are passionate about this mission, and it is our people who drive this mission to reality. Summit’s core values include integrity, passion for excellence, purposeful urgency, collaboration, and our commitment to people. Our employees are truly the heart and soul of our culture, and they are invaluable in shaping our journey toward excellence.

Summit’s team is inspired to touch and help change lives through Summit’s clinical studies in the field of oncology. Summit has multiple global Phase 3 clinical studies, including:

Non-small Cell Lung Cancer (NSCLC)

  • HARMONi: Phase 3 clinical study which was intended to evaluate ivonescimab combined with chemotherapy compared to placebo plus chemotherapy in patients with EGFR-mutated, locally advanced or metastatic non-squamous NSCLC who were previously treated with a 3rd generation EGFR TKI.

  • HARMONi-3: Phase 3 clinical study which is intended to evaluate ivonescimab combined with chemotherapy compared to pembrolizumab combined with chemotherapy in patients with first-line metastatic NSCLC.

  • HARMONi-7: Phase 3 clinical study which is intended to evaluate ivonescimab monotherapy compared to pembrolizumab monotherapy in patients with first-line metastatic NSCLC.

Colorectal Cancer (CRC)

  • HARMONi-GI3: Phase 3 clinical study intended to evaluate ivonescimab in combination with chemotherapy compared with bevacizumab plus chemotherapy.

Ivonescimab is an investigational therapy not presently approved by any regulatory authority other than China’s National Medical Products Administration (NMPA). Summit is headquartered in Miami, Florida, and has additional offices in California, New Jersey, the UK, and Ireland.

Overview of Role:

The Talent Acquisition Consultant will play a critical role in the recruitment process by identifying, attracting, and hiring top talent for the organization. Job Summary:
We are seeking an experienced SAP Fiori Developer to design, build, and enhance modern, user-friendly SAP applications that meet enterprise standards for usability, performance, and maintainability. In this role you will own the full Fiori/UI5 development lifecycle, working closely with functional consultants, ABAP developers, and UX teams to deliver responsive Fiori applications across desktop, tablet, and mobile devices.   • Solid experience with OData v2/v4 modeling and consumption.
  • Hands-on experience with HTML5, JavaScript (ES6+), and CSS.
  • Working knowledge of ABAP CDS views, BOPF, and gateway service development.
  • Experience deploying Fiori applications to ABAP frontend and BTP runtimes.
  • Strong understanding of authentication, authorization, and SAP security patterns.
  • Excellent attention to UX, accessibility, and performance.
  • Strong communication and documentation skills.

  • Identify and accelerate high-impact workloads by integrating NVIDIA's frameworks, libraries, and core software stack into research projects, and help researchers amplify their impact through publications, conference presentations, and technical content.

  • Advocate for accelerated computing, robotics, Multimodal AI and Physical AI, and deliver hands-on trainings, workshops, lectures and demonstrations across NVIDIA's platforms, and mentor power users to become NVIDIA champions.

  • Track emerging research trends and turn gaps between researcher needs and NVIDIA's offerings into prototypical solutions and direct feedback to NVIDIA Engineering.

  • Maintain deep expertise in your domain while staying versatile across NVIDIA's full platform: GPUs, CPUs, networking, and software

What we need to see:

  • A graduate degree from a leading university in a STEM related discipline.

  • 5+ years in the multimodal and world model lifecycle on multi-node GPU systems: video and image data curation at scale, pre-training and post-training, evaluation, and efficient inference.

We're looking for bilingual speakers to record short, casual voice clips where they naturally mix English with Spanish - the way they'd actually talk in real life. No script, no scenarios, just you talking about your day, your opinions, whatever comes naturally.

  • Audio quality: Clear voice, close to the mic, one speaker only, no echo. A headset or earbuds with a mic helps but isn't required

Why is this freelance opportunity a great fit for you?

  • Get paid to talk - no perfect grammar, no formality: up to $5 per hour equivalent depending on the project
  • Do it from your couch, your phone, wherever's comfortable
  • Flexible, from home, paid per approved recording
  • If you naturally mix Spanish and English when you speak, you're exactly who we're looking for

Your responsibilities extend to managing highly complex and escalated cases that require innovative problem-solving and a deep understanding of QAD and Progress systems. raw.description:
Charles and Ray Eames designed chairs. They also designed houses, exhibitions, films, toys, graphics, and one particularly famous lounge chair.

What connected their work wasn’t a medium. It was a way of thinking. They studied how people behaved, experimented constantly, and moved fluidly between the smallest details and the systems surrounding them. The result was work that made complicated things feel remarkably simple.

Growth design at Mercury requires a similar range.

Our Growth teams work across the journey people take with Mercury, from discovering us on the web to becoming a customer, finding value in the product, and eventually bringing other people along with them. That means the design problems are unusually varied. One day might involve rethinking how someone understands Mercury for the first time. Another might mean finding friction in activation, designing an experiment around conversion, or creating a new loop that helps a great product travel further.

We’re looking for a Growth Design Manager to lead design across this portfolio.

You’ll lead and develop a team of designers working across Conversion, Activation, and Virality. You’ll partner closely with Product and Engineering to identify the highest-leverage opportunities, turn ambiguity into a clear direction, and build a Growth design practice where experimentation and exceptional craft reinforce each other.

This is a role for someone who thinks about growth as a design problem, not simply an optimization problem.

In this role, you’ll:

  • Lead and develop the designers working across Mercury’s Growth organization, giving them the context, coaching, and feedback they need to do exceptional work
  • Partner with Product and Engineering leadership to shape Growth strategy, identify high-leverage opportunities, and turn them into compelling customer experiences
  • Help teams move from intuition to learning by using experimentation, customer insight, and business results to inform what we build next
  • Raise the quality bar across a broad set of experiences, from Mercury’s public web presence through conversion, activation, virality, and customer experience
  • Create clarity across an inherently ambiguous problem space. You’ll help teams decide which problems matter, where design can have the greatest impact, and what excellent execution looks like
  • Build the systems and operating practices that allow Growth Design to scale without becoming mechanical. You’ll create enough structure to help teams move quickly while preserving room for judgment, creativity, and ambitious ideas
  • Grow the team thoughtfully, helping us identify what kinds of designers we need and maintaining a high bar as the organization expands

You should:

  • Have experience leading and developing high-performing product or growth designers, including coaching senior designers through ambiguous, consequential work
  • Have a track record of using design to drive measurable business outcomes. You understand experimentation and growth mechanics, but you don’t sacrifice customer experience in pursuit of a metric
  • Be an excellent design thinker with strong visual and product judgment. You can evaluate the details of an experience while also seeing the larger system it belongs to
  • Be comfortable moving between leadership modes. Sometimes the team needs a strategic thought partner, sometimes a sharp critique, sometimes organizational clarity, and sometimes someone willing to get close to the work
  • Care deeply about developing people. You can set a high bar, give direct and thoughtful feedback, recognize what makes individual designers exceptional, and help them grow
  • Be curious about why people behave the way they do. The best growth ideas often begin with understanding a customer rather than staring at a funnel
  • Be comfortable operating independently in a fast-moving environment where the answer often isn’t obvious at the beginning

You don’t need to have spent your entire career with “Growth” in your title. Excellent candidates could come from product design, growth design, consumer products, commerce, or other environments where design quality and business performance are deeply connected.

What matters is that you can build a team capable of doing both: make Mercury easier to discover, understand, and adopt while making the experience itself better along the way.

raw.description:
About the company

At Covera Health, we're on a mission to improve healthcare by making every diagnosis more accurate.

Every year, millions of patients receive imaging that shapes life changing medical decisions. Yet too often, important findings are missed, patients struggle to access high quality imaging, and the healthcare system treats radiology like a commodity instead of one of the most critical moments in a patient's care journey.

We're changing that.

Covera combines clinical expertise, advanced AI, and one of the industry's largest radiology quality datasets to help detect disease earlier, improve diagnostic accuracy, and give clinicians greater confidence in every decision they make. Better diagnoses lead to better treatment, fewer unnecessary procedures, lower healthcare costs, and, most importantly, better outcomes for patients.

In 2026, Covera and Medmo came together to create the first platform designed to support the entire radiology journey. From helping patients find and schedule high quality imaging, to coordinating care, to ensuring the accuracy of every diagnosis, we're building a connected experience that simply hasn't existed before.

Backed by Insight Partners, our platform supports nearly 6 million people across Fortune 10 and Fortune 100 employers, three of the five largest national health plans, and thousands of value based primary care physicians.

This is an exciting moment to join Covera. We're building technology that is helping detect serious conditions earlier, improving the quality of care for millions of patients, and redefining what healthcare can be. If you're excited by meaningful work, ambitious teammates, and the opportunity to help save lives through better healthcare, we'd love to meet you.

About the role

As a Patient Experience Specialist working on the Medmo team, you'll play a vital role in helping patients navigate one of the most important moments in their healthcare journey.

When a patient needs an MRI, CT, ultrasound, or other diagnostic imaging, the process can be overwhelming. Finding the right facility, understanding costs, coordinating with providers, and scheduling an appointment often requires navigating a fragmented healthcare system.

That's where you come in.

As part of the Medmo team at Covera Health, you'll guide patients from referral to appointment, helping them access high quality, affordable imaging while delivering an experience that is compassionate, seamless, and efficient. You'll work closely with patients, healthcare providers, and imaging centers to remove barriers to care and ensure every patient receives the support they need.
