At LIC we are proud of our contribution to the New Zealand dairy sector. Our vision is to improve the prosperity and productivity of New Zealand farmers; and we want great people to join us on our journey.

The Livestock Improvement Patrick Shannon Scholarship Programme is named after one of the most remarkable and innovative bovine geneticists and reproductive biologists in the world. Dr Shannon joined Livestock Improvement in the mid-1950s, and made a variety of world-breaking discoveries, which continue to provide vitality and profitability to the New Zealand dairy industry.

Funding provisions and identification of candidates:

Scholarships will be awarded as one-off grants to successful honours students in their fourth year. For Masterates, grants may be a one-off grant or made in a series of progressive payments.

A selection panel from LIC's Research and Development team will assess applications according to set criteria (outlined below).

Where feasible, successful candidates may be encouraged to undertake one month's paid work at LIC's premises near Hamilton, prior to, or at the end of, their scholarship period.

The successful student(s) will be required to present the findings of their dissertation or thesis to LIC and make a copy of the dissertation or thesis available to the LIC library.

Academic excellence, with special emphasis on mathematics, statistics, machine learning, or science; records should be accompanied by a recommendation from the university's relevant head of department.

A commitment to working in genetics or machine/analytical learning, or any other area of interest to LIC.

The student will use the scholarship grant to complete their final year of study, gaining a qualification that enables them to enrol in a PhD programme.

raw.description:
Join a team that’s transforming mental healthcare. Founded by psychiatrists, Headlight is more than a company: it’s a movement. A movement that exists on the front lines of the mental health crisis, transforming the way people access care and the way clinicians deliver it. In order to help people in their time of need and ensure that every person who comes to us has options, we are transparent about our capabilities, treatments, and coverage, we champion innovation, and we leverage our rich data to continuously implement better ways of delivering care. Our mission is simple but powerful: Improving lives, one session at a time.
Our highly skilled and principled clinical team enjoys autonomy and institutional support so they can put their focus where it should be: on improving patient outcomes. Our clinicians want to do more than help individual clients, so they work to affect the system as a whole, elevating standards of care so that their efforts reverberate far beyond what they could do in private practice.
As the most trusted behavioral health partner in the Western U.S., we’ve established deep relationships that give us unparalleled access, interoperability, and first-priority referrals. This exclusivity, combined with our best-in-class coordinated care and feedback loops, results in superior outcomes and cost savings.
Our services are convenient, accessible, and expert, combining personalized client engagement with advanced technology to enhance, not replace, human connection. Indeed, we hold that human-to-human relationships are indispensable, so from the match to the session to the time between sessions, we provide whole person care so nobody falls through the cracks and there is a brighter path forward for all.

Our clinicians chose Headlight because…

  • Clinician Led Expertise : Headlight was founded and led by clinicians. Our Clinical Leadership team is at the forefront of every decision we make.
  • Admin Work on Autopilot: We handle insurance, billing, and marketing so you can focus on what you love – seeing clients.
  • Innovative Technology: By using Blueprint AI to capture session notes, clinicians can focus less on documentation and more on meaningful client interaction and connection
  • Competitive Benefits: We provide industry-leading benefits, sick leave, 401(k) contributions, and more.
  • Clinical Support: Consult with our Clinical Consult Groups or schedule case consultations with our leading clinician.
  • Clinical Autonomy: You have the autonomy to make decisions about patient care and treatment while having the backing and guidance of our experienced Executive Therapists and Psychiatrists for case consultations.
  • Collaborative Teams: Be a part of a collaborative team environment and a supportive community. Our clinicians are separated into small teams of 10 to 12, with a licensed clinical lead for assistance. You’re never alone in your journey.

Our Pillars

  • Make things easier.
  • Forge genuine connections.
  • Elevate the standard.

Headlight by the numbers

  • Access: The typical wait time to see a W2 Clinician is 4 weeks, Headlight significantly reduces this to an average of 8.9 days to see a W2 Clinician, with 80% of clients being seen within two weeks.
  • Retention and Therapeutic Relationships: Industry data indicates approximately 70% of clients return for a second therapy session. Headlight boasts a 92% return rate, reflecting Headlights ability to match clients to the right clinician.
  • Continuity of care: Of Clients who attend at least four sessions, only 36% continue with the same clinician in the broader industry. Headlight surpasses this with a 94% continuity rate.
  • Client Engagement and Attendance: Industry average for clients attending their first scheduled appointment is 65%. Headlight improves upon this with an 81% attendance rate, indicating effective initial engagement strategies.

Roles and Responsibilities

  • Establish positive, trusting rapport with patients
  • Diagnose and treat mental health disorders
  • Create individualized treatment plans according to patient needs and circumstances
  • Meet with patients regularly to provide counseling, treatment and adjust treatment plans as necessary
  • Conduct ongoing assessments of patient progress
  • Involve and advise family members when appropriate
  • Plan outreach and referral activities in surrounding communities

Qualifications

  • Minimum requirement of 12 months in a clinical setting after you have become fully licensed.
  • Master’s Level Degree or higher (Required) in related fields
  • Full, unencumbered LMFT, LCSW, LPC, LPCC or Psychologist license (license based on office location). Applicants without a valid, active license will not be considered. We are currently not hiring associate/intern level therapists.
  • Bilingual (English/Spanish) skills are a plus, but not required
  • Maintain professional licensure and/or certification throughout employment with this agency
  • Ability to work as a team member and cooperatively
  • Superb organizational skills
  • Ability to guide, direct, or influence people
  • Excellent written and oral communication skills
  • Able to establish and maintain effective working relationships with clients and their families
  • Electronic Health Record (EHR) Proficiency: Must have demonstrated experience in utilizing electronic health record systems efficiently to manage patient data, document clinical information, and access patient histories. Familiarity with NextGen is highly desirable.
  • Computer Skills: Strong computer literacy with proficiency in a range of software applications including word processing, spreadsheets, databases, and presentations. Ability to quickly adapt to new technologies and troubleshoot common issues.

Benefits

  • W-2 role with medical, dental and vision effective on the first of the month after employment
  • Base Salary and monthly Bonus based on billed hours
  • CEU support which includes earned CEU days and CEU reimbursements
  • Vacation, Sick, Holiday
  • Employee Assistance Program (EAP) provides confidential counseling services, resources, and support to help you navigate personal or professional challenges.
  • 401(k) plan with company contribution
  • Credentialing Support, Training and Development Opportunities, Growth Opportunities
  • Convenient work from home or hybrid options
  • Flexible schedule
If you need any accommodations for your interview please email prior to scheduling.
Not meeting all the requirements? Research indicates that women, communities of color, and historically underrepresented individuals are often hesitant to apply for jobs unless they meet every qualification. We are committed to cultivating a diverse, inclusive, and genuine workplace. If you're enthusiastic about this position but your previous experience doesn't precisely match every qualification listed, we enthusiastically encourage you to submit your application. You could be the ideal candidate for this role or others!
Headlight is committed to the principles of diversity, equity, and inclusiveness and seeks to create a working environment reflective of this commitment. We seek to provide a diverse clinician base to support the diversity of our clients. Headlight supports and respects diversity of people, culture, and ideas throughout our organization. Headlight thrives to be a welcoming, diverse and discrimination- and harassment-free workplace.
By applying for this position, you consent to receive future communications from Headlight via email or text regarding this application and related employment opportunities. You may opt-out at anytime by contacting us directly.

raw.description:
About Us

HighLevel is a cloud-based, all-in-one white-label marketing and sales platform that empowers marketing agencies, entrepreneurs, and businesses to elevate their digital presence and drive growth. We are proud to support a global and growing community of over 2 million businesses, from marketing agencies to entrepreneurs to small businesses and beyond. Our platform empowers users across industries to streamline operations, drive growth, and crush their goals. HighLevel processes over 15 billion API hits and handles more than 2.5 billion message events every day. Our platform manages 470 terabytes of data distributed across five databases, operates with a network of over 250 microservices, and supports over 1 million domain names.

Our People

With over 2000+ team members across 15+ countries, we operate in a global, remote-first environment. We are building more than software; we are building a global community rooted in creativity, collaboration, and impact. We take pride in cultivating a culture where innovation thrives, ideas are celebrated, and people come first, no matter where they call home.

Our Impact

Every month, our platform powers over 1.5 billion messages, helps generate over 200 million leads, and facilitates over 20 million conversations for the more than 2 million businesses we serve. Behind those numbers are real people growing their companies, connecting with customers, and making their mark - and we get to help make that happen.

Learn more about us on our YouTube Channel or Blog Posts

Who You Are:

You are a player-coach with genuine analytical depth and a builder's instinct. You do not wait to be asked — you surface what matters before it becomes urgent and bring recommendations, not just observations. You are comfortable walking into a room of experienced GTM leaders and challenging their thinking with data. You see broken workflows as problems to fix, not facts of life, and you have the operational credibility to implement the fix yourself. You thrive on unstructured problems and ambiguity is your baseline, not your blocker.

What You’ll Be Doing:

Strategic GTM Partnership

  • Work directly with Leadership across the Affiliates org — owning the RevOps narrative in every strategic conversation

  • Run weekly business reviews — own the narrative, surface the gaps, and bring action-oriented recommendations, not just summaries

  • Proactively surface insights Affiliates leadership is not yet asking for — conversion trends, cohort gaps, activation bottlenecks — before they become visible problems

  • Prepare and present monthly and quarterly performance reviews combining operational metrics, trend analysis, and forward-looking recommendations

Planning, Forecasting & Analytics

  • Own the bottoms-up annual operating plan for the Affiliates org — team composition, quota design, capacity modeling, and hiring plans

  • Drive the weekly bottoms-up forecast — collecting inputs, validating assumptions, and feeding consolidated outputs into the GTM-wide forecasting model

  • Track actuals against plan weekly — identify deviations early, diagnose root causes, and bring corrective recommendations before gaps compound

  • Build and own the core analytics framework: affiliate performance cohorts, LTV by affiliate segment, activation rate analysis, expansion triggers, and dormancy signals

  • Model the impact of proposed changes before they go live — new incentive structures, new activation playbooks, new affiliate tiers

Endorsed Affiliates Program — Ownership & Operations

  • Own end-to-end operational tracking of all Endorsed Affiliate agreements — milestone tracking, performance against contracted targets, and payout schedules

  • Build a centralized tracking system — moving from manual spreadsheets to a structured, automated operational model with real-time visibility

  • Track payout calculations and coordinate with Finance for approval and disbursement

  • Own the ROI framework — measuring actual return per endorsed partner and surfacing data-driven recommendations on where to invest, renew, or exit

  • Identify operational gaps and fix them through process design and automation

  • Produce regular reporting on program performance, payout status, and ROI for leadership

  • Cultivate a high-performing RevOps analyst cohort, fostering a culture of extreme ownership and strategic foresight

Process Design, Tech Stack & Team Leadership

  • Map, document, and own every key process across Land, Activate, and Expand — from onboarding workflows to expansion triggers

  • Conduct regular process audits — identify broken, redundant, or manually intensive workflows and fix them

  • Own the GTM tech stack for the Affiliates organization end-to-end — including affiliate tracking infrastructure and Endorsed Affiliates Program systems

  • Manage and develop a small team of analysts — set clear expectations, coach toward proactive instinct, and create a culture of ownership

What You’ll Bring:

  • Analytically sharp — comfortable building forecasting models, cohort analyses, and ROI frameworks from scratch

  • Systems and process oriented — you have opinions about how things should work and the ability to implement them

  • Player-coach mentality — comfortable executing directly while managing and developing a small team

  • Strong communicator across levels — managers, directors, and senior directors simultaneously

  • Experience owning a high-value partnership or contract program — tracking milestones, managing payouts, building ROI frameworks

  • Proven track record in high-growth SaaS where operational processes were being built in real time

Experience/Education/Certifications Required:

  • 5–8 years in Revenue Operations, Sales Operations, Partner Operations, or a closely adjacent GTM analytics function

  • Experience supporting or operating within a partner, affiliate, or channel ecosystem — strongly preferred

  • Background in high-growth SaaS where operational processes were being built, not just maintained

  • No specific certification required — analytical depth and track record of impact are the bar

The salary range for this position is $120000 - $140000 annually

Als Content Writer:in im Education-Team bei simpleclub erstellst du Inhalte wie Zusammenfassungen, interaktive Erklärungen und Aufgaben für den Beruf “Pflegefachperson”. Diese Lernbausteine baust du gemeinsam mit unseren Designer:innen mit Bildern, Animationen, Formeln und Grafiken zusammen. Deine Begeisterung für und Erfahrung im Umgang mit Künstlicher Intelligenz ist dabei entscheidend, um unsere Inhalte noch effizienter und innovativer zu gestalten. Gemeinsam mit dir bringen wir E-Learning voran und verändern die Zukunft der Bildung!

Wie du etwas bewegen wirst:

  • Du arbeitest mit dem Education-Team von simpleclub zusammen und erstellst Inhalte für den Ausbildungsberuf Pflegefachperson.
  • Du wirst für die Zusammenstellung von Inhalten mit Hilfe unserer Tools verantwortlich sein, indem du Lernbausteine erstellst und diese in Zusammenarbeit mit unseren Designer:innen mit Bildern, Animationen, Formeln und Grafiken zusammenbaust.
  • Du wirst Content für den Beruf Pflegefachperson planen.
  • Du wirst eng mit unserem Sales Team zusammenarbeiten und unseren Content Pflegeschulen und Kliniken vorstellen.

Worauf wir Wert legen:

  • Leidenschaft für Bildung: Du begeisterst dich für die Inhalte des Ausbildungsberufes und kannst diese somit verständlich vermitteln. Möglicherweise hast du die Ausbildung in diesem Bereich abgeschlossen oder hast Erfahrung und möchtest daher zu Innovationen im Bildungsbereich beitragen.
  • Begeisterung und Erfahrung mit Künstlicher Intelligenz
  • Kommunikations-Profi: Du hast die Fähigkeit, komplexe Themen in einfachere Konzepte herunterzubrechen, die leicht zu lesen und zu verstehen sind.
  • Teamplayer: Du arbeitest hart, aber du genießt es, mit dem Team gemeinsam zu feiern und Spaß zu haben. Bei uns geht es um die Balance.
  • Ausgezeichnetes Zeitmanagement: Du bist in der Lage, deine Arbeit und deinen Zeitplan zu organisieren, um wichtige Deadlines einzuhalten. Du bringst Zeit für einen wöchentlichen Arbeitsaufwand von ca. 15 bis 20 Stunden mit.
  • Flexibilität und Agilität: Wir sind dabei, ein vollständig agiles Unternehmen zu werden. Das bedeutet, dass du deine Zeit dort einteilen kannst, wo sie am meisten gebraucht wird, abhängig von der Priorität der Projekte. Kein Tag wird wie der andere sein.
  • Fließend Deutsch, sehr gute Englischkenntnisse (Firmenkommunikation auf Englisch)
  • Abgeschlossene Ausbildung als Pflegefachperson
Bonuspunkte, wenn:
  • Erfahrungen als Praxisanleiter:in oder Lehrer:in in einer Pflegeschule
  • Studium in den Bereichen Medizin oder Lehramt
  • Praktische Erfahrungen z.B. durch mehrere Stationen in Krankenhäusern

Was ist für dich drin:

  • Arbeiten von überall
  • Team-Events
  • Eine großartige Kultur
  • Weiterbildung
  • Teilnahme an einer sinnvollen Mission
  • Offene Kommunikation
💰Deine Vergütung: Wir 💙 Transparenz. Wir haben verschiedene Vergütungsstufen, anhand derer wir ein gerechtes Gehalt für jeden Bereich festlegen. Deine Vergütung wird mindestens einmal im Jahr überprüft. Das Gehalt für unsere Werkstudierendenstellen liegt dabei bei 15€ pro Stunde. Bei umfangreicher Erfahrung in relevanten Bereichen kann das Startgehalt in Einzelfällen auch auf bis zu 17€ pro Stunde angepasst werden.

Wir haben in allen Stellenbeschreibungen Gehaltsangaben eingeführt, um sicherzustellen, dass wir alle Mitarbeiter:innen fair behandeln. Sobald wir uns besser kennengelernt haben und deine Fähigkeiten und Erfahrungen während des Vorstellungsgesprächs verstanden haben, können wir einschätzen, welches Gehalt für dich passend ist.
🌍 Bei simpleclub sind alle willkommen. Ja, wirklich alle.
Wir bei simpleclub setzen uns für den Aufbau einer Arbeitsumgebung ein, die Gleichheit, Integration und Vielfalt fördert. Auf unserem Expansionskurs sind wir überzeugt, dass die Einzigartigkeit jeder:s Einzelnen gefeiert und anerkannt werden sollte. Dies ist entscheidend für unseren Erfolg und unsere Innovationen. Wir möchten ein Produkt schaffen, das von allen geliebt wird, und wir möchten, dass sich das auch in unseren Teams zeigt.

Uns ist es wichtig, dass unsere Mitarbeiter:innen sich selbst in die Arbeit einbringen, unabhängig von Alter, ethnischer Zugehörigkeit, Religion, Staatsbürgerschaft, sexueller Orientierung, Behinderungsstatus, Neurodiversität, Hautfarbe, Glauben, Geschlecht oder anderem.

In diesem Sinne arbeiten wir kontinuierlich daran, dass simpleclub ein vielfältiges und integratives Umfeld für alle bleibt.

raw.description:
Join a National Top Workplace

Named a Top Workplace in the USA and Top Remote Workplace, Kobie is where the best minds in loyalty come together, driven by passion and innovation. We’re always looking for talented individuals who are ready to join a collaborative, growth-focused culture. As a partner to some of the world’s most recognized brands, we are leaders in loyalty, helping brands build lasting emotional connections with their consumers.

Join Us from Anywhere

While our headquarters are nestled in sunny St. Petersburg, Florida, Kobie embraces a flexible work environment, offering teammates the freedom to work remotely. We understand the importance of work-life balance and support our team with:
·Flexible Time Off to recharge when needed
·Nine Company-Wide Holidays
·A diverse suite of benefits prioritizing your growth, development, and personal well-being
Discover more about our perks and benefits here.
Kobie is a values-led organization where we believe that everyone is a leader, regardless of their position or role.
Travel Requirements:
As a remote-first organization headquartered in St. Petersburg, Florida, Kobie values meaningful in-person connection and collaboration that strengthens our teams, supports our clients, and enhances our culture. While travel requirements vary by role, periodic travel may be required to support business objectives, team collaboration, customer engagements, training, and company events. Candidates should be able and willing to travel as needed to fulfill the responsibilities of the role.

About the team and what we’ll build together

The Marketing Operations team is Kobie’s campaign execution engine — delivering outbound loyalty communications for some of the world’s most recognized brands. As a Marketing Ops QA Analyst, you’ll serve as the final quality gate before any campaign reaches a client’s loyalty members. You’ll work closely with Developers and Campaign Managers to validate every outbound communication — ensuring it’s accurate, compliant, on-brand, and aligned to the campaign’s intended audience and strategy.

How you will make an impact

As a Marketing Ops QA Analyst, you own defect identification, tracking, and sign-off — and no campaign ships without your clearance.

  • Review and validate all outbound campaigns prior to deployment — including email content, subject lines, personalization, and dynamic elements
  • Verify audience targeting logic, segmentation, and suppression lists against campaign specifications
  • Confirm data integrity: validate that merge tags, personalization fields, and offer content are rendering correctly for the right audiences
  • Check all links, UTM parameters, and redirect destinations for accuracy
  • Validate platform configuration — send settings, throttling, scheduling, from name/address — against approved specs
  • Assess campaigns against brand standards, legal and compliance requirements, and messaging strategy
  • Log and track defects in the team’s QA system; communicate findings clearly to Development for resolution
  • Own QA sign-off gates in the deployment workflow — campaigns do not deploy without QA clearance
  • Review quality-related post-launch issues and feed findings back into QA frameworks and checklists
  • Maintain and improve QA documentation, checklists, and testing standards over time

At the end of the first year, success means: defect rates on deployed campaigns stay below 2%, QA reviews are completed within SLA windows, and every defect log is clear enough for Development to resolve without back-and-forth

What you need to be successful

Required

  • Bachelor’s degree or equivalent experience
  • 1–3 years of experience in QA, marketing operations, or digital campaign review
  • Familiarity with email marketing platforms and campaign QA workflows
  • Strong analytical eye — able to catch discrepancies in data, copy, and configuration that others miss
  • Understanding of audience segmentation, targeting logic, and suppression requirements
  • Methodical, process-oriented approach; comfortable working from checklists and documented standards
  • Clear communicator — able to describe defects precisely and escalate risks without ambiguity

Preferred

  • Working knowledge of HTML/CSS email rendering
  • Familiarity with Salesforce Marketing Cloud or equivalent enterprise ESP
  • Experience using defect tracking tools (Jira, or similar)
  • Knowledge of AMPScript or dynamic content logic in campaign platforms

raw.title: Junior Business Development Manager

raw.description:
Bouw mee aan de groei van Nedcargo — en aan je eigen commerciële carrière

Ben jij commercieel, nieuwsgierig en klaar om het vak van business development echt te leren? Krijg je energie van nieuwe contacten, het ontdekken van kansen en het bedenken van oplossingen voor klanten? Dan is dit jouw kans om je bij Nedcargo te ontwikkelen tot een volwaardige Business Development Manager.

Je wordt onderdeel van ons commerciële team in Nederland en België. Je werkt nauw samen met ervaren collega’s, gaat mee naar klanten en beurzen en leert hoe logistieke oplossingen, offertes, tenders en contracten tot stand komen. Vanaf het begin krijg je verantwoordelijkheid, maar je staat er nooit alleen voor.

Over Nedcargo

Nedcargo is een toonaangevende logistieke dienstverlener voor de food- en beveragesector. Vanuit onze vestigingen in Nederland en België helpen wij producenten, importeurs en bekende merken succesvol te zijn in hun markt.

Wij bieden geïntegreerde oplossingen op het gebied van warehousing, transport, forwarding, value-added services, douane, accijnzen en internationale supply chains. Voor sommige klanten verzorgen we de import naar Europa, voor andere de wereldwijde distributie.

Onze missie is helder: We enjoy making our customers win.

Dat doen we volgens onze vier kernwaarden: bevlogen betrokkenheid, investeren in de toekomst, continu verbeteren en recht door zee.

Nedcargo heeft grote ambities. In de komende vijf jaar willen we onze omzet verdubbelen en onze positie in de Benelux verder uitbouwen richting West-Europa. Daarom investeren we niet alleen in technologie en duurzame logistiek, maar vooral ook in nieuw commercieel talent.

Hoe ziet jouw werkdag eruit?

Als Junior Business Development Manager leer je stap voor stap hoe je nieuwe klanten wint en bestaande klantrelaties verder uitbouwt. Je combineert commercieel denken met inhoudelijke kennis van logistiek en supply chains.

Je werkzaamheden bestaan onder andere uit:

  • commerciële kansen ontdekken bij bestaande en potentiële klanten;

  • prospects onderzoeken en benaderen via deskresearch, social selling en netwerken;

  • klantbezoeken in binnen- en buitenland voorbereiden en bijwonen;

  • meewerken aan offertes, businesscases, tenders en klantvoorstellen;

  • jouw eigen salespipeline opbouwen en beheren;

  • deelnemen aan nationale en internationale food- en beveragebeurzen;

  • samenwerken met Operations, Customer Support en Supply Chain Engineering;

  • klanten helpen met slimme, schaalbare en duurzame logistieke oplossingen.

Naarmate je groeit, krijg je steeds meer verantwoordelijkheid en bouw je jouw eigen klantenportefeuille op. Ons doel is duidelijk: jou opleiden tot een zelfstandige Business Development Manager volgens de Nedcargo way of working.

Requirements

Wat verwachten we van jou?

Wij zoeken niet per se iemand met een lang cv. We zoeken vooral iemand met commerciële energie, nieuwsgierigheid en de ambitie om snel te leren. Jij:

  • hebt mbo+- of hbo-werk- en denkniveau;

  • bent commercieel, ondernemend en resultaatgericht;

  • legt gemakkelijk contact en durft initiatief te nemen;

  • bent nieuwsgierig naar logistiek, food en beverage;

  • kunt goed luisteren en complexe vragen helder maken;

  • werkt graag samen, maar neemt ook zelf verantwoordelijkheid;

  • spreekt en schrijft goed Nederlands en Engels;

  • herkent jezelf in de kernwaarden van Nedcargo.

Stage- of eerste werkervaring in sales, logistiek of supply chain is welkom, maar niet noodzakelijk. Mentaliteit, talent en ambitie vinden wij minstens zo belangrijk.

Wat bieden wij jou?

Bij Nedcargo krijg je de ruimte om te leren, initiatief te nemen en daadwerkelijk invloed te hebben op onze groei.

Je kunt rekenen op:

  • een marktconform salaris;

  • intensieve begeleiding door ervaren commerciële collega’s;

  • een duidelijk groeipad naar Business Development Manager;

  • opleidingen via de Nedcargo Academy;

  • veel vrijheid, afwisseling en verantwoordelijkheid;

  • contact met bekende internationale klanten;

  • klantbezoeken en beurzen in binnen- en buitenland;

  • een goede pensioenregeling en vakantiegeld;

  • aandacht voor gezondheid en vitaliteit via Nedcargo Vitaal;

  • vooral: een ambitieus en betrokken team in Nederland en België.

Klaar om te groeien?

Wil jij je commerciële carrière starten bij een organisatie die de ambitie heeft om dé toonaangevende duurzame supplychain-innovator voor food en beverage in Europa te worden? Reageer dan door op de knop solliciteren te drukken of stuur dan je sollicitatie naar . Onze procedure bestaat uit een telefonische kennismaking, een eerste gesprek en een verdiepend tweede gesprek. Een VOG-aanvraag maakt onderdeel uit van de procedure.

raw.title: Gestionnaire de Compte

raw.description:
Libérez votre potentiel chez Steritech – Où les carrières se construisent de l'intérieur

Chez Steritech, nous cultivons une culture d'apprentissage continu et de développement professionnel. Nous sommes fiers de dire que la majorité de notre équipe de direction a commencé son parcours avec nous en tant que spécialiste. Cela témoigne de notre forte conviction en la promotion interne et de la reconnaissance du potentiel de chacun de nos membres. Lorsque vous rejoignez Steritech, vous ne prenez pas simplement un emploi – vous entrez sur un chemin de carrière qui offre des opportunités de croissance et d'avancement à tous les niveaux. Nous vous fournissons les outils, les ressources et le mentorat pour vous aider à réussir, car votre succès est notre succès. Faites partie d'une équipe qui s'engage à votre développement et vous aider à monter dans votre carrière !

Sommaire du poste

Le gestionnaire de comptes (GC) est un poste au sein de l'équipe de l'expérience client, relevant du directeur des comptes stratégiques de son segment de marché. Le GC est le principal point de collaboration pour apporter de la valeur aux clients assignés. Le portefeuille de clients présente une complexité faible à moyenne. Le GC est la personne responsable de développer des relations solides, de fournir un soutien quotidien et d'apporter des perspectives techniques afin d'exécuter une stratégie de compte maximisant le rendement pour le client et pour Steritech.

Une partie essentielle de ce poste consiste à orchestrer la mise en œuvre des services, à assurer la qualité et la calibration des spécialistes évaluant les sites, à respecter les ententes sur les niveaux de service, ainsi qu’à communiquer et acheminer les problèmes aux instances supérieures lorsque nécessaire.

De plus, le gestionnaire de comptes doit posséder une compréhension approfondie du secteur des normes de marque (Brand Standards), des protocoles et procédures de Steritech, ainsi que des exigences spécifiques des marques clientes afin d'assurer un service de haut niveau et de faciliter une excellente communication entre Steritech et tous les paliers de l'organisation cliente.

Requirements

Responsabilités et tâches principales

  • Gestion de la relation client : Établir des relations productives, professionnelles et consultatives avec le personnel clé (niveaux franchise et siège social).
  • Coordination interne : Coordonner l'implication de l'équipe verticale (spécialistes, soutien, technique, opérations) pour atteindre les objectifs de performance.
  • Lien stratégique : Mettre en relation les parties prenantes du client avec l'équipe Steritech (revues d'affaires, rencontres de haute direction, sessions d'innovation).
  • Expertise de marché : Maintenir une connaissance approfondie du segment de marché, partager les tendances et les meilleures pratiques.
  • Suivi de la performance : Évaluer proactivement la qualité, la calibration, la répartition des tournées et gérer les ententes de service.
  • Objectifs financiers : Atteindre les cibles de croissance, de rentabilité et de recouvrement (A/R). Travailler avec le département de la comptabilité pour les factures en souffrance.
  • Contrats : Gérer les renouvellements de contrats et les négociations d'augmentation de prix.
  • Planification : Exécuter les plans stratégiques incluant les cibles financières et les étapes critiques.
  • Analyse des besoins : Valider proactivement les besoins des clients pour ajouter de la valeur à leurs programmes.
  • Rapports : Soumettre les rapports hebdomadaires, mensuels et annuels requis.

Profil du candidat

Expérience et qualifications requises

  • Bilinguisme (français et anglais) : Un atout majeur pour ce poste.
  • Minimum de trois ans d'expérience en vente stratégique (B2B) ou en gestion de comptes.
  • Expérience dans l'industrie de la restauration, de l'alimentation, des dépanneurs ou de la restauration rapide (QSR).

Leadership et aptitudes personnelles

  • Autonomie et capacité à performer sous pression avec tact et habileté.
  • Capacité démontrée à mener à bien des projets et des initiatives complexes.
  • Excellentes compétences en communication, tant à l'oral qu'à l'écrit.
  • Capacité de négociation efficace et sens des affaires aiguisé.
  • Grand souci du détail et solides compétences en prise de décision.
  • Maîtrise des applications Google (Docs, Sheets, Calendar, Drive, etc.).
  • Disponibilité pour voyager (auto et avion) pour rencontrer les clients et assister aux conférences.
  • Réussite des vérifications d'antécédents (conduite, casier judiciaire, dépistage de drogues).

Éducation et formation

  • Baccalauréat en administration, en gestion ou domaine connexe OU trois ans d'expérience progressive en gestion dans une industrie de services OU réussite du parcours interne de gestion de comptes.

Benefits

  • Prime annuelle
  • Téléphone cellulaire et ordinateur portable fournis par l’entreprise
  • Congés fériés, vacances et congés de maladie payés par l’entreprise
  • Excellents avantages sociaux, incluant les assurances médicale, dentaire, visuelle et vie
  • Programme d’aide aux employés offrant notamment des services de counseling gratuits et d’autres avantages
  • Régime d’épargne-retraite avec une contribution de l’employeur très compétitive de 3,5 %
  • Rabais employés
  • Excellents programmes de remboursement des frais de scolarité et de bourses d’études

The Role: Talent System Administrator (JSON)

About the Role:

We’re seeking a JSON Developer to help build and enhance features within our SaaS talent marketplace through Eightfold AI. This role combines hands-on coding—particularly working with JSON-driven configurations and integrations—with ongoing support for end-user and internal technical issues. You’ll contribute to UI-related enhancements, implement platform changes, and help troubleshoot and resolve production support queries.

Key Responsibilities:

  • Develop and maintain features, enhancements, and platform changes for the talent marketplace using JSON-based approaches.
  • Support UI updates and improvements that are driven by configuration, data models, and front-end/back-end integration patterns.
  • Build, test, and document changes to ensure releases meet quality and reliability expectations.
  • Investigate and resolve technical issues reported through the support process, including reproducing bugs and analyzing logs/requests/responses.
  • Collaborate with stakeholders (e.g., product, operations, support, and engineering teams) to translate requirements into working solutions.
  • Provide timely, accurate support for platform-related inquiries, including root-cause analysis and follow-up actions.
  • Maintain clear technical documentation for implemented changes, troubleshooting steps, and known issues.
  • Participate in iterative improvements to development and support workflows.
  • Design and co-own end-to-end integration architecture.
  • Define data migration strategy (initial loads, delta syncs, reconciliation).
  • Lead technical discovery workshops with stakeholders.
  • Establish integration design patterns and governance standards.
  • Provide technical leadership across delivery lifecycle.

Required Qualifications:

  • SQL + ETL tools explicitly
  • Data modeling + transformation experience.
  • Experience with integration frameworks (REST, SSO, middleware).
  • Experience leading implementations or technical workstreams.

Preferred Qualifications:

  • Experience with UI-related enhancements (e.g., implementing configuration changes that affect screens, workflows, or user experiences).
  • Familiarity with common SaaS deployment practices, release cycles, and support/incident workflows.
  • Experience with scripting or programming languages commonly used alongside JSON (e.g., JavaScript/TypeScript, Python, Java, or C#).
  • Experience using API testing tools and log/telemetry sources to diagnose issues.
  • Knowledge of learning-focused workflows or education technology platforms.

Success in This Role:

You’ll be effective when you can consistently turn JSON-driven requirements into reliable platform updates and when you can support production operations by quickly diagnosing issues, fixing defects, and communicating resolutions.

Welcome to Fi.

We’re a passionate team from Square, Google, Oura, Peloton, Uber, and more working to transform the human-pet relationship. Our mission? Develop cutting-edge technology to revolutionize what it means to be a pet parent. The pet industry remains firmly stuck in the past and we are here to change that. Fi is leveraging our team's talent and expertise to improve the lives of millions of pets in the U.S. Real-time location tracking, activity, sleep and behavior monitoring – and that's just the beginning.
The most exciting aspect of our work? Bridging the communication gap between pets and humans. Imagine a world where everyone knows how their pet feels in real time and how to keep their best friend in good shape. That's the future we're building at Fi.
If you're someone who thrives in innovative, collaborative work environments and feels strongly about helping pets live longer, better lives, Fi could be the perfect fit. Join us in our pursuit of the “impossible,” or as we call it here “let me find a way,” to redefine the future of pet ownership together.

Fi is looking for a Rescue Partnerships Manager!

Fi is looking for a Rescue Partnerships Manager to be front-of-house for Fi's rescue program. You find the rescues, tell the story, close the partnership, and get new partners live. Rescues lose dogs every week: fosters slip leashes, transports go sideways, new adopters have escape artists. You'll pitch a program that solves that for no cost to the rescue, then own the relationship until the rescue is fully up and running. This is a sales and growth role, not account management. Day-to-day partner support and triage sits with the rest of the team. Your job is new partners, activated fast.

What You'll Do:

  • Recruit new rescues into the program: Prospect, build target lists, and get in the door with shelters and rescue organizations nationwide, from scrappy foster-based rescues to the largest humane societies in the country
  • Pitch the program: Run discovery and pitch calls that show rescue leadership how free GPS trackers and microchips prevent lost dog events and protect the dogs they've worked hard to save
  • Own onboarding end to end: Be each new partner's main point of contact from signing up to fully live: first order, device setup, team training, and their first dogs protected. Hand off a healthy partner to the account team
  • Run webinars: Host recurring onboarding and program webinars that convert interested rescues into active partners at scale
  • Represent Fi in the rescue world: Attend rescue conferences, adoption events, and industry gatherings as the face of the program
  • Run your pipeline like an operator: Keep the CRM clean, forecast your numbers, and report on recruitment, onboarding velocity, and adoption-transfer performance. You'll be measured on results, not activity
  • Feed the roadmap: Bring what you hear from the rescue community back to product and ops so the program keeps getting better

What You'll Bring:

  • Genuine belief in rescue, dogs, and technology, all three, no exceptions, with a drive to prove tech can save dogs' lives
  • Time on the ground at a rescue, whether as staff, a volunteer, or a close partner, and a real understanding of their constraints: volunteer labor, tight budgets, chaos, and hearts fully in it
  • A natural feel for selling and presenting, equally comfortable pitching leadership, hosting a webinar for 50 rescues, or working a booth at a conference
  • An analytical, numbers-first instinct, tracking pipeline and conversion rates and letting data decide where time goes
  • Speed picking up new tools (CRM, AI tools, internal systems) and patience teaching non-technical partners how to use ours
  • A build for pace, ready for a fast-moving startup with constant context switching and real ownership from week one
  • Bonus: already networked in the rescue community, with doors that open on day one

Why You'll Love Us:

  • Time to Recharge: Enjoy flexible PTO to take the breaks you need.
  • Top-Notch Health Coverage: We’ve got your back (and teeth and eyes) with full medical, dental, and vision insurance.
  • Wellness Perks: Free access to One Medical, Kindbody, and Talkspace to keep you feeling your best.
  • Dog-Friendly Office: Bring your pup to work — they’re part of the team, too.
  • Give Back to the Pups: Make tails wag with a $500 annual donation to a dog charity of your choice through our BarkBack Program.
  • Free Fi Membership: Your furry best friend(s) get all the benefits of a Fi collar, on us!
  • Love for Friends + Family: Share the Fi magic with loved ones through our gifting program.

Upsunners are a remote, global workforce, and we thrive in a multicultural team. We are committed to open source and an open, welcoming environment. Our team spans the globe and the experience spectrum.

raw.description:
Most Microsoft 365 jobs are about keeping the lights on. This one is about turning the lights off — on the manual work, at least. We are looking for an engineer who treats every repetitive ticket as a bug in the system, and who works with the team to fix the system.

You will share ownership of the platform our company works in every day — Exchange, Entra ID, Teams, and increasingly Microsoft 365 Copilot — alongside the rest of Technology Operations. Keeping it healthy is the baseline. The actual job is making it require less human intervention each quarter than it did the last — through automation, better defaults, and self-service that people genuinely prefer over opening a ticket.

This role suits someone who genuinely enjoys IT operations and the Microsoft platform, and who wants to spend their time working across the business — with security, compliance, the service desk, and the teams we support — to make the organization more efficient and better prepared. The measure of success here is business value: hours given back to the people we support, risk reduced, and costs avoided — delivered with a service mindset that treats every colleague as a customer whose time matters.

What You'll Actually Do

Automate the toil away

  • Kill the repeat tickets — when the same request shows up for the third time, you and the service desk decide it is worth automating, and you build the fix instead of closing tickets faster. Power Automate, PowerShell, Microsoft Graph, Logic Apps — whatever fits.
  • Build self-service — access requests, group management, and common fixes that users can resolve without waiting on IT.
  • Measure what you removed — we care about the tickets that stopped happening, not the ones you closed quickly.
  • Get Copilot ready — permissions hygiene, oversharing remediation, and sensitivity labeling with security and compliance, then agents and pilots where a team has a real problem worth solving.

Treat the tenant like a platform

  • Configuration as code — tenant changes should live in version control and go through peer review, not in someone's memory of what they clicked.
  • Ship changes safely — test, roll out deliberately, and be able to roll back. Change management as engineering practice, not paperwork.
  • Documentation and roadmap — runbooks and notes people actually trust.

Keep the core solid

The forward-looking work only earns trust if the fundamentals hold, and the people we support feel well served day by day. A meaningful share of the role is still hands-on operations:

  • Exchange Online and Entra ID operations — mail flow, connectors, transport rules, and email authentication (SPF, DKIM, DMARC); Conditional Access, MFA and passwordless rollouts, SSO integrations, directory sync, and privileged access.
  • Tier-3 escalation for M365 issues — root cause analysis that produces a permanent fix — plus a shared on-call rotation and occasional maintenance windows.

We care more about how you think than about the exact boxes you tick. If you meet most of this and are genuinely interested in the rest, apply.

  • You've run M365 in production — roughly 3–5 years administering a real tenant with real users, including Exchange Online and Entra ID.
  • You script by default — PowerShell is your reflex, and you have used Microsoft Graph to do things the admin portals cannot.
  • You debug to root cause — authentication failures, mail delivery problems, and sync errors get investigated — and what you find gets written up and shared, not just restarted.
  • You're already curious about Copilot — whether through hands-on admin work, building agents, or serious self-directed learning.
  • You write well — clear documentation and plain-language explanations for non-technical colleagues. This matters more on a remote team.
  • You work well with others — comfortable partnering across IT and the business, strong at asynchronous communication, and calm when something breaks at an inconvenient hour.
  • You lead with service — you treat colleagues as customers, communicate clearly while an issue is open, follow through past the point where the ticket closes, and use what you hear from them to decide what to fix next.
  • You connect work to outcomes — you can explain what a project saves, prevents, or enables in terms the business recognizes, and you prioritize accordingly.

Bonus Points

  • Hands-on work with Copilot Studio, declarative agents, or Graph connectors.
  • Infrastructure-as-code experience (Bicep, Terraform, Azure Automation) or CI/CD applied to tenant configuration.
  • Defender for Office 365 or Defender for Identity.
  • Hybrid Exchange or migration experience, including tenant-to-tenant moves.
  • Certifications such as MS-102, SC-300, or AZ-104 — useful signal, not a requirement.
  • Experience in a regulated environment with formal audit requirements.

Working Here

  • Fully remote, with a preference for candidates in the Eastern or Central time zone so there is real overlap with the team.
  • Less than 25% travel for occasional team meetings and site visits.
  • On-call rotation shared across the team — nobody carries it alone.
  • Education: a degree in a technical field is welcome, and equivalent hands-on experience is equally welcome.

About Bold Orange:


Bold Orange (BOCO) is a customer experience company. We believe authentic human connections are the single most important driver of business and societal progress. We exist to create these connections across the customer lifecycle, from acquisition to engagement to retention. Our culture is one of curiosity, collaboration, proactivity and always bringing the outside, future focused perspective to our clients.

Position Summary:

    Bold Orange (BOCO)’s growing Analytics & Insights team is seeking a Senior Analyst with at least 5 years of hands-on experience analyzing marketing & transactional customer datasets and experience utilizing statistical models and tests to bring forward insights into the customer experience.

    The Senior Analyst will lead the hands-on analytics of client projects end-to-end, with support and mentorship from a Director. This work can include identifying datasets worth analyzing, provisioning & cleaning data, data exploration & modelling (segmentation, forecasting, A/B testing, etc.), developing actionable insights, designing and building compelling data visualizations, and presenting findings and recommendations to clients.

    Across BOCO Analytics projects, the Senior Analyst will need to leverage previous experience and bring a curious, creative energy for continuous learning. Our team brings a curious and agile mentality to exploring new domains in customer analytics. We apply fundamental understanding of analytics skills to diverse datasets that may include POS / Ecomm transactions, search / AI & web engagement, email & SMS, media investment, product and store reviews and more.

    The ideal candidate has a strong curiosity for understanding customer experience and a desire to explore how each touchpoint defines a customer’s relationship with a brand. They bring at least 5 years of hands-on marketing analytics experience including knowledge of SQL / Python, comfort with Snowflake and/or other cloud data platforms, and demonstrated experience organizing, integrating, analyzing, and interpreting data to form a clear, compelling story.

Responsibilities:

    • Analyze integrated marketing and customer journey datasets to understand the drivers of success/failure in the context of client strategy and develop clear recommendations for a non-technical audience.
    • Enrich and analyze clients’ transactional data to understand what drives customer value, how purchasing patterns are shifting over time, and what levers they can pull to maximize customer loyalty and lifetime value.
    • Explore and learn to leverage new analytics datasets and tools, helping clients understand how they can support insights and optimization.
    • Design, build, and train clients to understand reporting, dashboards, and performance insights for ongoing client delivery (Data Studio, PowerBI, Tableau, PowerPoint).
    • Present and discuss analysis with internal stakeholders and clients, including adapting content for different audiences.
    • Build and maintain data architecture documentation to ensure clarity across teams on what datasets are canonical and where they come from.

Required Qualifications:

    • At least 5 years’ domain experience within marketing, retail, or customer analytics or a related field.
    • Experience with data analysis & visualization tools including Tableau, PowerBI, Data Studio or similar.
    • Experience with deep analysis of customer & transactions data, including segmentation, customer lifetime value (LTV), churn/loyalty risk analysis, propensity modeling, etc.
    • Experience using AI tools (including skills / agents) to accelerate data analysis, code generation, or insight development.
    • Bachelor’s degree in business, analytics, data science, economics, social sciences, or related discipline with exposure to statistical / quantitative analysis.
    • Working knowledge of SQL and Python for analytics and data warehouses (Snowflake, Databricks, AWS Redshift, BigQuery, etc.)
    • Ability to thrive in a highly collaborative, cross-functional environment where analytics supports and works closely with tech, strategy, and client teams.
    • Innately curious and desire to learn new skills and new tools
    • Excellent communication skills – verbal and written. This is a client-facing analytics role.

Preferred Qualifications:

    • Experience using analytics to persuade business stakeholders to change practices, make new investments, and/or shift priorities.
    • Experience with digital experience analytics tools including Google Analytics, Google Ads, Meta Ads, TikTok Ads, and/or SEMRush.

Benefits That Matter:

Our benefits are designed to support life’s many stages—expected and unexpected. Eligible employees can access:
• Medical, dental, and vision insurance
• Virtual mental health support
• Health Savings and Flexible Spending Accounts (including dependent care)
• Infertility and critical illness benefits
• 401(k) with generous 6–10% employer contribution
• Paid parental leave
• Tuition reimbursement
• Free parking and commuter support
Note: Some benefits apply only to full-time employees.

Who We Are:

Our tone is professionally sassy. We embrace meat raffles, hot seats, and the occasional Jell-O shot. We like staff meetings that are informative, educational, and at times, damn funny. We believe in no hierarchy, no bullshit, no politics. Just honest, hard work and great fun.
Important to note: While we value AI as a tool, AI is not invited to Bold Orange interviews. We want to meet the wonderfully talented human you! Any suspected use of AI to inform or assist, while actively in an interview with Bold Orange, will result in exclusion from consideration for the role to which you applied or were referred.

Equal Opportunity Employer:

We are an equal opportunity employer, dedicated to a policy of nondiscrimination in employment on any basis including race, color, creed, gender, sexual orientation, age, disability, religion, national origin, marital status, familial status, ancestry, status as a veteran, status with regard to public assistance and any other characteristic protected by law. Bold Orange does not and will not discriminate against employees, prospective employees, clients, or vendors.

Senior Product Specialist

Remote (UK)

Do you want to help shape software that affects thousands of lives?

Who are we?

We are ranked as the UK’s #1 construction specific software player and our mission is simple; to provide market leading end-to-end software solutions to the construction and construction like industries across the entire build life cycle.

If you are looking to build an exceptional career with an award-winning company you’ve come to the right place. Our teams are based in the UK, Europe, and India, working on products that are used on a global scale. We have a clear and defined road map to deliver over the next 3 years, which is centred around a large-scale digital transformation as well as continuing our growth and expansion.

We embrace diversity and equality and want our employees to be comfortable bringing their whole selves to work. We are committed to building a team with a variety of backgrounds, skills and views. Creating a culture of Equality isn’t just the right thing to do, it improves every aspect of our business.

Purpose

The Senior Product Specialist is responsible for translating product strategy into high-quality, deliverable outcomes, while acting as a senior subject matter expert within their domain.

This role combines strong product delivery capability with deep industry expertise, ensuring that solutions are both technically robust and aligned to real-world customer needs. As a senior individual contributor, the Senior Product Specialist plays a key role in shaping backlog priorities, improving delivery practices, and supporting the development of others within the team.

Key Responsibilities

Backlog Ownership & Refinement

  • Own, manage, and continuously refine product backlogs, ensuring clarity, prioritisation, and alignment to product strategy

  • Translate strategic initiatives and discovery insights into detailed, high-quality user stories and acceptance criteria

  • Ensure backlog items are appropriately sized, sequenced, and ready for delivery

Delivery Planning & Execution

  • Lead backlog refinement and sprint planning with a high degree of autonomy and confidence

  • Support the team in delivering complex or high-impact initiatives, ensuring alignment to expected outcomes

  • Contribute to release planning and coordinate dependencies across teams where required

Team Enablement & Leadership (Non-People Management)

  • Act as a senior point of contact for the development team, providing clarity on complex requirements and edge cases

  • Proactively identify and remove blockers, improving team flow and delivery effectiveness

  • Support and mentor Product Specialists, sharing best practices and raising overall team capability

Quality & Acceptance

  • Support and guide QA and UAT processes, particularly for complex or high-risk features

Stakeholder & Feedback Management

  • Build strong relationships with stakeholders, confidently managing expectations and navigating competing priorities

  • Facilitate discussions to refine requirements, challenge assumptions, and drive clarity

  • Communicate delivery progress, risks, and trade-offs effectively

Performance Monitoring & Continuous Improvement

  • Analyse product performance, delivery metrics, and team effectiveness to identify improvement opportunities

  • Proactively recommend and implement improvements to processes, tools, and ways of working

Domain & Industry Expertise

  • Act as a recognised subject matter expert (SME) within your domain, with deep understanding of industry practices, workflows, and challenges

  • Apply advanced domain expertise to shape solutions, influence prioritisation, and improve product design

  • Partner with customers and stakeholders as a trusted advisor, particularly in complex or high-value scenarios

  • Ensure solutions reflect industry best practice and deliver meaningful customer value

Key Skills, Experience and Qualifications

Product Delivery & Agile Expertise

  • Strong experience as a Product Owner, Business Analyst, or Product Specialist within an agile environment

  • Proven ability to manage complex backlogs and deliver high-quality outcomes

  • Deep understanding of agile practices and their practical application in delivery teams

Industry & Domain Expertise

  • Deep and demonstrable expertise within the relevant industry domain

  • Experience working closely with customers or within the industry in a hands-on capacity

  • Ability to apply domain knowledge to solve complex problems and improve product outcomes

  • Strong understanding of relevant regulatory, commercial, or operational considerations

  • Recognised as a go-to expert for domain-specific knowledge and decision-making

Collaboration & Communication

  • Strong communication and facilitation skills, particularly in complex or ambiguous scenarios

  • Ability to influence stakeholders and drive alignment without formal authority

  • Proven ability to work effectively across Product, Engineering, Design, and customer-facing teams

Analytical Thinking & Problem Solving

  • Advanced analytical and problem-solving skills, with the ability to handle complex scenarios

  • Ability to use data, insights, and experience to inform decisions and recommendations

Quality & Delivery Focus

  • Strong focus on quality, with experience ensuring robust acceptance criteria and delivery standards

  • Ability to balance delivery pace with completeness and usability

  • Experience improving team delivery practices and outcomes

Tools & Technical Familiarity

  • Strong familiarity with product and delivery tools (e.g. Jira, Azure DevOps, Confluence)

  • Comfortable working with technical teams and understanding system architecture, constraints, and dependencies

Our Values

We areUnited. As part of a team, we’re better together.

We areAgile. Be the change, we’re on a journey.

We areTrusted. Do the right thing, we own this.

We areDriven. Get stuck in, we make it happen.

Benefits

We strive, year on year, to achieve recognition as an award-winning workplace that our employees love. We’ve selected just a few of the many benefits available below to show you how we take care of our Causeway stars.

Like all responsible companies Causeway is aware of the need to recognise the importance of protecting our environment and addressing the climate emergency. raw.description:
About the Role

Mirantis is building out our Neocloud service offering — managing large-scale infrastructure to a high SLA for customers running demanding compute workloads. As that offering scales, so does the volume and complexity of telemetry we need to collect, correlate, and act on. We're looking for an Observability Platform Engineer to design and build the monitoring, logging, tracing, and alerting platform that our operations teams depend on to detect and resolve incidents fast — at large scale, across a globally distributed environment.

This is a hands-on, build-it role. You'll be the person who turns "we have no visibility into this" into a platform that surfaces the right signal at the right time, and turns "we found out from the customer" into "we caught it before they noticed."

Key Responsibilities

  • Design, build, and operate observability platform components — metrics, logging, distributed tracing, and alerting — for large-scale infrastructure environments

  • Build telemetry pipelines capable of handling high cardinality, high volume data from large fleets of infrastructure, with an eye on cost, retention, and query performance

  • Define and implement SLO/SLI frameworks and alerting strategies that reduce noise and surface real signal to on-call engineers

  • Partner closely with service delivery and operations teams to understand what they need to see during an incident, and build for that — not just for dashboards nobody opens

  • Integrate observability tooling with incident management workflows, including root-cause analysis support and post-incident review data

  • Continuously improve detection speed and reduce mean-time-to-detect (MTTD) and mean-time-to-resolve (MTTR) across the platform

  • Contribute to the roadmap for AI-assisted operations tooling (e.g., automated triage, anomaly detection, engineer-assist tooling) as it matures

  • Own the reliability, scalability, and security of the observability stack itself — it needs to be up when everything else is on fire

  • Document architecture, runbooks, and operational practices so the platform is maintainable beyond you

What Success Looks Like

  • Operations teams can diagnose incidents faster because the right data is surfaced automatically, not hunted for manually

  • Alert volume is high-signal, low-noise — engineers trust what fires

  • The observability platform scales cleanly as infrastructure footprint grows, without cost or performance surprises

  • Reduced MTTD/MTTR trends, tracked and demonstrable over time

  • A platform other engineers actually want to build on, not work around

  • Proven experience designing and building observability platforms for large-scale, production infrastructure environments (not just consuming an existing setup — actually building one)

  • Strong hands-on experience with metrics, logging, and distributed tracing tooling (e.g., Prometheus, Grafana, OpenTelemetry, Loki, Thanos/Cortex/Mimir, Elasticsearch/OpenSearch, Jaeger/Tempo, or equivalents)

  • Experience with high-volume telemetry pipelines and the tradeoffs involved (cardinality, retention, cost, query latency)

  • Strong software engineering skills in at least one language commonly used in this space (e.g., Go, Python, Rust)

  • Experience with Kubernetes and cloud-native infrastructure

  • Solid understanding of SLO/SLI/error-budget practices and alerting design that minimizes noise

  • Comfortable working in a fast-moving environment where the platform is being built out alongside the infrastructure it's monitoring

  • Strong communication skills — able to work directly with operations/service delivery teams to understand real incident-response needs, not just technical specs

Preferred Skills & Experience

  • Experience building observability for GPU/HPC infrastructure or other specialized, high-performance compute environments

  • Experience with eBPF-based observability tooling

  • Familiarity with AIOps/ML-based anomaly detection or automated triage systems

  • Experience operating in a managed services or MSP context, where observability directly drives customer-facing SLAs

  • Contributions to open-source observability projects

What does Mirantis offer you?

- Work with an established Silicon Valley leader in the cloud infrastructure industry;
- Work with exceptionally passionate, talented and engaging colleagues, helping Fortune 500 and Global 2000 customers implement next-generation cloud technologies;
- Be a part of cutting-edge, open-source innovation;
- Thrive in the high-energy environment of a young company where openness, collaboration, risk-taking, and continuous growth are valued;

- Professional development and training;

- Attend conferences and working groups;

- Company outings, happy hours, hackathons, and tech talks;
- Receive a competitive compensation package with a strong benefits plan.

It is understood that Mirantis, Inc. may use automated decision-making technology (ADMT) for specific employment-related decisions. Opting out of ADMT use is requested for decisions about evaluation and review connected with the specific employment decision for the position applied for. You also have the right to appeal any decisions made by ADMT by sending your request to

submitting your resume, you consent to the processing and storage of your personal data in accordance with applicable data protection laws, for the purposes of considering your application for current and future job opportunities.

We are a Leader for Container Management in G2 (#2 after AWS)!

We are a Leader for Container Management in G2 (#2 after AWS)!

About Mirantis

Mirantis is the Kubernetes-native AI infrastructure company, enabling organizations to build and operate scalable, secure, and sovereign infrastructure for modern AI, machine learning, and data-intensive applications. By combining open source innovation with deep expertise in Kubernetes orchestration, Mirantis empowers platform engineering teams to deliver composable, production-ready developer platforms across any environment—on-premises, in the cloud, at the edge, or in sovereign data centers. As enterprises navigate the growing complexity of AI-driven workloads, Mirantis delivers the automation, GPU orchestration, and policy-driven control needed to manage infrastructure with confidence and agility. Committed to open standards and freedom from lock-in, Mirantis ensures that customers retain full control of their infrastructure strategy.

Mirantis serves many of the world’s leading enterprises, including Adobe, DocuSign, Liberty Mutual, PayPal, Reliance Jio, Societe Generale, Splunk, and Volkswagen. Learn more at .

Position Summary:

The Director of Clinical Education is responsible for the strategic planning, execution, and operational management of enterprise-wide clinical education and professional development initiatives. This leader oversees the infrastructure, processes, budgets, content governance, and logistics that support the delivery of high-quality clinical learning programs across the organization.

The Director serves as a key partner to clinical leadership, operational leaders, and subject matter experts to ensure clinical education programs are scalable, effective, fiscally responsible, and aligned with organizational goals. This role combines program management, budget oversight, stakeholder engagement, and team leadership to drive consistent and impactful learning experiences that support clinical quality, compliance, workforce development, and patient outcomes.

Job Description:

Key Responsibilities

Clinical Excellence Program Leadership

  • Lead the operational strategy and execution of the organization's Clinical Excellence and clinical education programs.

  • Develop and maintain an annual clinical training roadmap aligned with business priorities and workforce development needs.

  • Establish standards, processes, and governance for training program delivery across multiple regions, specialties, and clinical functions.

  • Partner with executive and clinical leaders to identify educational priorities and support organizational initiatives.

Training & Learning Operations

  • Oversee the planning, scheduling, and delivery of clinical education curriculum and training programs, workshops, symposiums, leadership development programs, and continuing education events.

  • Ensure a consistent and high-quality learner experience across virtual, in-person, and hybrid programs.

  • Drive improvements in learning operations, training effectiveness, and program scalability.

  • Monitor participation, completion rates, learner feedback, and educational outcomes.

  • Obtain all required state approvals and accreditation required for courses to deliver continuing education hours for participating clinicians.

Content & Curriculum Management

  • Provide oversight of training content development, maintenance, and distribution.

raw.title: Italy, Southern Europe, Africa Regional Senior Associate
raw.excerpt: JOB DESCRIPTIONABOUT CONTEXT TRAVELContext Travel is a global day tour operator that connects intellectually curious travelers with local subject matter experts in over 60 destinations around the world.
raw.description:
JOB DESCRIPTION

ABOUT CONTEXT TRAVEL

Context Travel is a global day tour operator that connects intellectually curious travelers with local subject matter experts in over 60 destinations around the world. Our guests often tell us that we are the best part of their trip, and we take great pride in creating unforgettable moments that are treasured for a lifetime.

Context is a long-standing company founded in 2003. We have been backed by growth equity since 2017.

ROLE: Regional Senior Associate - Italy, Southern Europe and Africa

LOCATION: Remote role

SCHEDULE: Monday-Friday, 8:00 AM - 5:00 PM GMT

SALARY: Commensurate with experience

JOB DESCRIPTION

Context’s Delivery team ensures the seamless execution of exceptional cultural experiences for all stakeholders—clients, travel advisors, guides, vendors, venues, and partners. We create highly personalized experiences while maintaining smooth and efficient operations.

The Regional Senior Associate - Italy, Southern Europe and Africa is a key member of the Italy, Southern Europe, Africa Delivery team. This is a hybrid commercial and operational role. You will own high-value custom requests from first enquiry to confirmed booking, and you will hold deep knowledge of the regional portfolio. The role has two equal halves. The first is client-facing and commercial: converting custom enquiries, advising clients and advisors, and maximizing the value of each booking. The second is behind the scenes: keeping the regional portfolio accurate and fulfillable, working directly with our experts, and using data and tools to improve our regional operations.

The role reports to the Regional Senior Manager - Italy, Southern Europe and Africa, and will work closely with the Regional Director and the Regional Delivery team.

ROLE AND RESPONSIBILITIES

  • Own the end-to-end journey for custom and high-value regional requests, from initial qualification and proposal design to closing the sale and identifying upsell opportunities.
  • Serve as the primary, proactive contact for clients and advisors, ensuring all proposals are commercially sound, operationally feasible, and accurately tracked.
  • Maintain expert knowledge of the ISEA portfolio to ensure fulfillability, support product development, and turn recurring custom requests into repeatable products.
  • Monitor backend configurations and flag seasonality risks or portfolio gaps before they impact bookings.
  • Manage 1:1 expert communications and build trusted relationships with the regional community, thoughtfully matching experts to clients based on context and expertise.
  • Provide clear briefings on custom content and collect expert feedback to drive continuous product improvement.
  • Triage the regional inbox daily by urgency and value, maintaining strict data hygiene through consistent tagging and accurate information transfer.
  • Maintain communication templates and canned responses to ensure high-quality, reportable regional data.
  • Analyze regional trends and root causes to identify client and operational pain points, providing actionable recommendations for cross-functional resolution.
  • Fluently utilize the tech stack and AI tools to optimize drafting, research, and data tasks, sharing best practices with the team.
  • Design, document, and lead new regional workflows and efficiency projects to improve the overall client experience.
  • Mentor and train seasonal contractors and Delivery colleagues.
  • Support onboarding of new regional teammates and act as a resource for best practice.
  • Actively contribute to weekly Delivery team and cross-regional meetings.
  • Participate in region-agnostic initiatives and lead project working groups.

KEY STRENGTHS AND IMPACT AREAS

  • Commercial instinct. Converts custom enquiries into confirmed, profitable bookings without losing the personal touch.
  • Portfolio depth. Knows the Italian, Greek, Turkey and Africa product well enough to answer most questions without escalating.
  • Technical fluency. Adopts tools, including AI, and turns them into time saved for the whole team.
  • Data discipline. Tags, records, and reports accurately, so regional decisions are based on real numbers.
  • Pattern recognition. Sees the trend behind the individual complaint and proposes the structural fix.
  • Expert relationships. Trusted by the expert community, and able to brief them well under time pressure.

WHAT YOU’LL BRING

Required

  • 2+ of experience in travel, hospitality, or a comparable client-facing commercial role.
  • Proven experience selling or building custom, high-value travel or service proposals with an eagerness to close the sale and celebrate the win
  • Native-level English and Italian written and spoken (required), with strong professional judgement in sensitive client and expert-facing communications
  • Deep familiarity with and passion for Italy (required), including 3+ years lived or directly relevant professional experience, with a knack for inspiring others to visit.
  • Demonstrated autonomous ownership: can triage, decide, and close loops without heavy supervision.Sincere enthusiasm for connecting with clients both via email and over the phone
  • Confident with CRM, booking, and communication platforms; fast to learn new systems.
  • Comfortable working with data: building a report, reading it, and explaining what it means.
  • You are someone who does not stop at the task in front of them. This person spots patterns, brings them to the team, and proposes the process or the tool that fixes the problem for good. Comfort with technology — including AI tools — is central to the role, not a nice to have.
  • Resilience and composure—you handle unhappy clients with empathy and a thick skin
  • Cultural sensitivity—you have experience and/or interest in working with colleagues and people from around the globe
  • A curious, learning-driven mindset—you’d happily be one of our clients yourself

Preferred

  • Knowledge of Greece or other Southern Europe destinations.
  • Greek or another regional language.
  • Experience writing SOPs or training material.
  • Background in cultural heritage, art history, archaeology, or a related field.

In exchange, we are thrilled to offer:

  • A supportive, mission-oriented work environment with colleagues who care
  • Unlimited access to digital lectures and, audio guides, and in-person small group tours
  • Annual enrichment stipend to pursue personal and professional interests
  • Tech stipend
  • Flexible PTO (with no caps, encouraged minimums, and parental leave)
  • A remote-first work policy - we have colleagues based in all four corners of the world
  • An annual company retreat to connect and celebrate with colleagues in person. (Past locations include New York City, Philadelphia, Lisbon, Barcelona, Mexico City, and Berlin. In 2024 we took the whole company to our birthplace, Rome, to celebrate our 20th anniversary.)

Context Travel is an equal-opportunity employer. We celebrate diversity and are committed to creating an inclusive environment for all employees. If you have a disability or special need that requires accommodation, please let us know.
