raw.description:
Senior Engineering & Integration Manager

About the company:

In the coming decades, our world needs substantially more critical minerals such as copper, lithium, and cobalt, to build electric infrastructure, vehicles, data centers, and electronics. The mining industry is making 10x fewer discoveries per dollar spent on exploration compared to 30 years ago, because the easy-to-find, near surface deposits have largely been discovered.

KoBold is a leading scientific mineral exploration, mine development, and technology development company. Our goal is to turn mineral exploration into a repeatable science to make discoveries faster—by integrating artificial intelligence, human intelligence, and new technology. We made our first discovery—Mingomba, one of the world’s largest undeveloped high-grade copper deposits—after spending materially less than the industry average. This asset is expected to operate for decades, and be a leading global copper supplier. KoBold is actively running exploration programs in 8 countries worldwide, all with the potential for another high-quality discovery.

We are developing Mingomba by applying the same technical rigor to resource development and mine planning as we do to exploration. Mingomba is also a scientific laboratory where we prototype new technology and workflows, combined with the expertise of veteran engineers. Our multidisciplinary team consists of mine and processing engineers, geologists, data scientists, software engineers, community, health & safety, construction, and operations specialists. We want to develop world-class mining projects that are safer and have more predictable outcomes for ourselves, partners, and communities.

KoBold is privately held; investors include institutional asset managers T. Rowe Price and Canada Pension Plan Investments; technology venture capitalists Andreessen Horowitz, Breakthrough Energy Ventures, BOND Capital, Durable Capital, StepStone, and Standard Investments; and strategic natural resources companies BHP and Mitsubishi.

About the role

This is a senior Engineering leadership role for the development of a significant Copper mining complex in Zambia. The Mingomba deposit contains over 10 million tonnes of copper more than half of which exceeds 6% grade. This role will help turn that world class deposit into a world class mine.

The Senior Engineering & Integration Manager is the primary technical authority for the Mingomba copper project through its design and construction phase. Reporting to the Project Director, this role carries end-to-end accountability for the quality, integrity, and integration of all engineering across the owner's team, the EPCM and specialist contractors. The role is the technical decision-maker and design authority for the project, responsible for safeguarding Kobold’s interests through stage gates, design reviews, and construction handover to operations. The Senior Engineering & Integration Manager sets the direction for engineering delivery, resolves complex cross-discipline technical issues, and directly influences how the Mingomba project is designed and built.

What this role is accountable for delivering

This role exists to ensure against common failure modes on major capital projects, with particular emphasis on scope creep driven by unresolved technical decisions, design quality that does not survive construction, and an owner's team that cannot effectively challenge or govern its engineering service providers.

The successful candidate will be judged on:

  • Engineering delivered on time, within sanction cost, and to the standard required for safe, operable, and maintainable facilities.
  • A design that has been constructability-reviewed, value-engineered, and operability-tested before it is frozen.
  • An EPCM that is technically directed, not just administered, with KoBold holding design authority.
  • A project that passes independent technical assurance reviews and stage-gate approvals without material qualification.
  • A technical risk register that is live, owned, and actively driven down.

Key responsibilities

Technical authority and design governance

  • Hold and exercise design authority on behalf of KoBold. Making and recording binding technical decisions across all disciplines, with a clear escalation path to the Project Director for issues that affect schedule, cost, or safety.
  • Establish the basis of design, engineering standards, and design criteria for the project, and enforce them with both the owner's team and the EPCM.
  • Own the technical risk register: identify, quantify, and drive the resolution of engineering risks before they become scope changes or construction rework.
  • Approve key engineering deliverables including P&IDs, design criteria, equipment datasheets, and technical specifications.
  • Direct the scope freeze process: define what decisions must be made to freeze design at each stage, own the timeline for those decisions, and prevent scope growth after sanction.

EPCM direction and performance management

  • Act as KoBolds senior technical interface to the EPCM as an active director of engineering scope, priorities, and performance.
  • Monitor engineering service provider progress against the engineering management plan using earned value metrics and escalate deviations in quality, schedule, or cost before they compound.
  • Direct EPCM and specialist contractor technical performance by challenging design solutions, enforcing design and lifecycle cost requirements, and proactively mitigating interface risks to ensure scope alignment.

Constructability, operability, and value engineering

  • Lead formal constructability reviews at FEL 2 and FEL 3, ensuring construction knowledge is embedded in the design before it is frozen.
  • Drive operability and maintainability reviews with the operations and maintenance readiness team at each design milestone, ensuring the facility can be safely operated and maintained as designed.
  • Lead structured value engineering sessions; ensure cost optimisation decisions are evidence-based, preserve safety and operability margins, and are captured in the design basis.
  • Benchmark key design parameters and cost drivers against comparable copper projects and IPA / industry data; identify outliers and resolve them with the EPCM and design leads.

Project integration and stage-gate delivery

  • Own the engineering integration across all disciplines and resolve inter-discipline conflicts, managing shared interfaces, and ensuring the project design is coherent end-to-end.
  • Prepare and present the engineering case for each stage-gate review; ensure the technical content is decision-ready, the assumptions are explicit, and the residual risks are quantified.
  • Oversee and enforce the project change control process, ensuring EPCM compliance and managing the technical, cost, and schedule impacts of scope changes.
  • Lead lessons-learned integration from comparable projects into the Mingomba design; establish a formal mechanism for capturing and applying lessons during execution.
  • Direct engineering interface management with external stakeholders, regulators, power counterparties, infrastructure providers, and the Zambian technical authorities.

Process safety and hazard management

  • Own the engineering dimension of process safety for the project and be accountable that HAZOPs, HAZIDs, SIL assessments, and process safety reviews are completed, actioned, and closed out.
  • Act as design authority for safety-critical systems (including isolation philosophies, shutdown logic, and structural integrity), ensuring all decisions are documented, traceable, and preserved throughout project design and construction.
  • Provide engineering input to the project's safety case and regulatory submissions; represent the KoBold engineering position in interactions with regulators.

Engineering data, quality, and handover

  • Establish and oversee the engineering data management framework, including version control and handover protocols, while maintaining the deliverables register to ensure a current, complete, auditable technical record.
  • Direct the engineering quality plan: define hold points, witness points, and independent review requirements across the design and construction phases.
  • Implement KoBold engineering and business standards; provide technical governance through a structured review and audit programme across the owner's team and EPCM.

People, capability, and operational readiness

  • Build and lead a high-performing KoBold engineering team, setting clear accountabilities, developing capability, and creating a culture of technical rigour and challenge.
  • Define the engineering resourcing plan through each project phase; identify gaps and direct recruitment or secondment to fill them ahead of demand.
  • Ensure the operational readiness team is embedded in the design process from the outset, and that design decisions reflect operability and maintenance requirements.
  • Mentor senior engineers; establish a structured technical development pathway within the project organisation.

Qualifications and experience

  • 18+ years of professional engineering experience in major capital projects in mining, minerals processing, oil and gas, or equivalent heavy industry, with a significant portion as the lead engineering authority on the owner's side.
  • Demonstrated track record of delivering projects through full lifecycle from FEED to mechanical completion, including at least one project above $700M total capital cost.
  • Deep experience managing and directing EPCM contractors with the ability to distinguish between EPCM advisory and owner technical authority, and to hold that line under schedule pressure.
  • Strong multi-discipline technical foundation with the ability to assess and challenge designs across civil/structural, mechanical, process, electrical, and instrumentation disciplines. Experience with Mine Processing and Infrastructure is an advantage.
  • Capability in constructability reviews, operability reviews, value engineering, and HAZOP/HAZID facilitation on complex facilities.
  • Experience developing and executing engineering management plans, technical risk registers, design basis documents, and stage-gate technical submissions.
  • Exposure to earned value management, engineering progress measurement, and performance reporting in an owner's team context.
  • Strong communication and influencing skills: able to present technical positions to project leadership, boards, regulators, and external technical stakeholders with equal clarity.
  • Bachelor's degree (or higher) in an engineering discipline; Chartered Engineer status or equivalent professional registration strongly preferred.
  • Experience in African or similarly complex operating environments is an advantage
  • Ability and willingness to travel internationally to Zambia, with anticipated travel of 90+ days per year.

KoBold Metals is an equal opportunity workplace and an affirmative-action employer. We are committed to equal employment opportunities for people of any race, color, ancestry, religion, sex, marital status, national origin, age, citizenship, or disability.

A DAY IN THE LIFE

Blattner Company, a Quanta Services operating company, is building a Crane & Rigging Center of Excellence (CoE) to coordinate crane expertise, standards, training, and fleet deployment across the Quanta family of operating companies. This is a founding role: the Senior Director will stand up a function that does not fully exist yet, earn the trust of operating companies across the enterprise, and deliver measurable value within the first year backed by a mandate, a budget, and the support of Blattner and Quanta leadership.

Quanta’s operating companies collectively run one of the largest crane fleets in North American construction. The CoE exists to help those operating companies navigate that complexity, deploy assets more effectively, and operate to a consistent standard of safety and technical excellence.

STEP INTO THE ROLE

  • Stands up the CoE from an early-stage function into a recognized enterprise resource hiring the team, establishing operating cadence, and building the operating-company relationships that make the function valuable.
  • Manages a growing team of crane and rigging professionals, including dedicated hires, fractional contributors from Blattner’s operations, and subject matter experts from other Quanta companies.
  • Manges the CoE’s budget and is accountable for the value it delivers utilization improvement, cost avoidance, standards adoption, and incident reduction.
  • Represents the CoE to Quanta operating company leadership, Blattner’s executive team, and Quanta corporate leadership.

WHAT YOU’LL NEED

  • Bachelor’s degree in construction management, engineering, business, or a related field, or an equivalent combination of education and field experience.
  • 12 or more years of leadership in crane and rigging operations, heavy lift planning, or construction equipment management in heavy civil, power generation, renewable energy, or industrial construction; hands-on experience across more than one crane market strongly preferred. 9 or more years of experience leading teams required.

WHAT SETS YOU APART

  • Ability to travel 40-50% of the time.
  • NCCCO certification (any applicable discipline) preferred; AEMP, CEMP, or equivalent equipment-management credentials preferred.
  • Crane knowledge — deep working knowledge of crane types (lattice boom crawlers, all-terrain, rough terrain, boom trucks, and tower cranes) and the lift environments each is suited to.
  • Experience — hands-on experience across more than one crane market; a background spanning utility-scale renewable work and at least one of gas generation, data center construction, heavy industrial, or high-voltage transmission is strongly preferred.

HOW WE INVEST IN YOU

  • Competitive pay
  • 100% employer paid HDHP insurance premiums for employees
  • 401(k) with company match
  • HSA and FSA options
  • Dental and Vision insurance
  • Education Assistance (Tuition Reimbursement)
  • Work/Life balance
  • Employee/Family focused culture
  • Gym on site
  • And more!
$195,966.00 - $284,150.00 Individual Compensation to be determined based on the applicant's applicable experience and qualifications balanced against internal equity.

WHO ARE WE?


With more than 115 years of construction experience, Blattner has played a vital role in building America’s critical infrastructure, ranging from railroads and highways to dams and mines. Since 1997, the company has focused on renewable energy solutions and is responsible for some of the most significant solar, wind and storage projects in the U.S. Today, Blattner has installed over 20% of America’s utility-scale wind, solar and energy storage capacity. Blattner Company is the parent company of Blattner Energy and D.H. Blattner & Sons, of which all are members of the Quanta Services family of companies. Company headquarters are in Avon, Minnesota.

Senior macOS Software Engineer (Swift/SwiftUI)

Remote

Join the team behind Parallels Desktop, one of the world’s leading applications for Mac users.

We’re looking for a Senior macOS Software Engineer to help build and evolve the native user experience of Parallels Desktop. You’ll work with Swift, SwiftUI, AppKit, and modern macOS technologies to deliver features used by millions of customers worldwide.

This role combines new feature development, architecture improvements, and modernization of an established codebase. You’ll collaborate closely with Product, Design, QA, and Engineering teams to create exceptional user experiences while helping shape the future of one of the most recognized productivity applications on macOS.

If you’re passionate about building high-quality Mac applications and enjoy solving complex technical challenges at scale, we’d love to hear from you.

Why Join Parallels?

Work on a product used by millions

Parallels Desktop is trusted by millions of users around the world to seamlessly run Windows applications on macOS. Your work will directly impact a large and engaged customer base.

Shape the future of a mature platform

You’ll help modernize and evolve a sophisticated macOS application, balancing new SwiftUI development with thoughtful improvements to an established codebase.

Remote-first culture

We believe great work can happen anywhere. Whether you work from a home office, a coworking space, or your favorite coffee shop, we provide the flexibility and autonomy to do your best work.

Work with exceptional people

Join a collaborative team of experienced engineers, designers, and product leaders who care deeply about craftsmanship, innovation, and delivering great customer experiences.

What You’ll Do

  • Build high-quality native macOS experiences using Swift and SwiftUI
  • Design, develop, and ship new features for Parallels Desktop
  • Collaborate closely with Product Managers, UX Designers, QA, and fellow engineers
  • Translate product requirements into scalable and maintainable technical solutions
  • Improve and modernize existing functionality through thoughtful refactoring
  • Troubleshoot and resolve complex issues impacting product quality and customer experience
  • Participate in architecture discussions and contribute to technical decision-making
  • Review code, mentor teammates, and help raise engineering standards across the team
  • Contribute to continuous improvement of development processes, tooling, and code quality

Required Qualifications

  • 5+ years of professional software development experience
  • Strong commercial experience with Swift
  • Experience building and shipping native macOS applications
  • Strong knowledge of SwiftUI and AppKit
  • Familiarity with Cocoa, Foundation, and Combine frameworks
  • Experience with Swift concurrency (async/await, structured concurrency)
  • Strong debugging, troubleshooting, and problem-solving skills
  • Ability to design maintainable, scalable software architectures
  • Experience delivering production-quality features throughout the software development lifecycle
  • Good understanding of Objective-C and interoperability with modern Swift code
  • Excellent communication and collaboration skills
  • Self-driven mindset with strong ownership and accountability
  • Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or equivalent practical experience

Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience with C++ or Objective-C++
  • Experience with Swift ↔ C++ interoperability
  • Experience building client-server or distributed applications
  • Experience developing automated tests and improving test coverage
  • Familiarity with Git, Jira, and Confluence
  • Experience working on large-scale commercial desktop applications
  • Experience modernizing legacy codebases

About Parallels

Parallels is a leader in virtualization and end-user computing solutions, helping individuals and organizations work seamlessly across Windows, macOS, Linux, mobile devices, and the cloud.

For more than two decades, Parallels has delivered innovative solutions that combine performance, security, and simplicity, enabling users to access the technology they need anytime, anywhere, on any device.

Today, millions of customers worldwide rely on Parallels products to power productivity in both personal and professional environments.

What We Offer

  • Fully remote work environment
  • Flexible working hours
  • Competitive compensation package
  • Opportunity to work on a globally recognized product
  • Collaborative and supportive engineering culture
  • Professional growth and development opportunities
  • Work-life balance that respects your time and priorities

Parallels is an equal opportunity employer. We celebrate diversity and are committed to creating an inclusive environment for all employees.

If you’re excited about building world-class macOS applications and making an impact on a product used by millions, we’d love to hear from you.

raw.description:
Radiology is the second most used healthcare service, used by over 51% of the workforce annually. Despite the critical role of radiology in healthcare, the process for undergoing a medical imaging exam has remained unchanged for decades. OneImaging is solving this with a concierge approach and a premium-quality radiology network of over 5,000 vetted providers across 48 states, which also reduces imaging costs by 60-80%. Our solution helps patients and families access essential radiology services at fair prices and without surprise bills, all while delivering immediate savings and ROI for employers and payers on every exam.

About the Role

OneImaging is building out its internal IT helpdesk to support a growing organization of approximately 300 employees. We are seeking a Tier 2 IT Support Operations Specialist to serve as the escalation point for complex technical issues that go beyond first-touch resolution. This role owns root-cause troubleshooting, systems and identity administration, and the technical depth that keeps our support operation reliable as it scales. You will partner closely with the Tier 1 Specialist — handling escalations, mentoring on complex tickets, and helping standardize how recurring problems are diagnosed and resolved. As a small team of 3, this role will also cover Tier I support as needed. This role reports directly to the Director of IT Operations.

Key Responsibilities

  • Own escalated tickets from Tier 1, diagnosing and resolving complex hardware, software, networkconnectivity, and access issues with independent judgment.
  • Perform root-cause analysis on recurring problems and partner with the Director to drive permanent corrective fixes rather than repeat break-fix work.
  • Administer identity and access systems, including Google Workspace administration, group and access management, and endpoint/device management (MDM, Context-Aware Access).
  • Support and troubleshoot core business applications, integrations, and vendor-specific software escalations.
  • Configure, image, and deploy endpoints; manage device lifecycle, patching, and endpoint security in coordination with IT Operations.
  • Mentor the Tier 1 Specialist by reviewing closed tickets, sharing troubleshooting techniques, and shadowing on complex issues.
  • Build and maintain knowledge base articles, runbooks, and documented escalation paths that raise first- touch resolution rates over time.
  • Coordinate with third-party vendors and internal stakeholders to resolve multi-faceted incidents, tracking them to closure in Linear.
  • Contribute to the monthly reporting and recurring-problem analysis the Director produces, surfacing trends from the escalation queue.
  • Support IT projects, rollouts, and process-improvement initiatives as the support function matures.

Required Qualifications

  • 3+ years of experience in IT support, with demonstrated Tier 2 / escalation-level troubleshooting.
  • Strong Windows and macOS desktop troubleshooting skills, plus solid networking fundamentals (DNS, DHCP, VPN, connectivity).
  • Hands-on experience administering Google Workspace or Microsoft 365, including identity, access, and group management.
  • Experience with endpoint/mobile device management (MDM) and endpoint security.
  • Proficiency with a ticketing system (Linear, Jira, ServiceNow, or similar) and strong documentation habits.
  • Excellent problem-solving skills and the ability to work escalations independently through to root cause.
  • Strong written and verbal communication, with the ability to mentor junior staff and explain technical concepts to non-technical users.
  • Associate's degree in IT or related field, or equivalent experience; high school diploma or GED required.

Preferred Qualifications

  • CompTIA Network+ / Security+, ITIL Foundations, or Google Workspace Administrator certification.
  • Scripting or automation experience (PowerShell, Python, or Google Apps Script) to eliminate repetitive support tasks.
  • Experience supporting a healthcare or other regulated environment, including HIPAA and PHI handling.
  • Experience with Slack administration and helpdesk automation tooling (e.g., Linear Asks intake, ClearFeed).
  • Prior experience mentoring Tier 1 staff or helping formalize a growing helpdesk function

raw.description:
Position Summary

The New Mexico Immigrant Law Center (NMILC) seeks a creative, organized, and mission-driven Creative Design and Digital Media Intern to support NMILC’s visual identity, digital communications, and immigrant-rights advocacy efforts.

This paid, part-time internship provides a meaningful opportunity to build practical experience in graphic design, photography, social-media management, website content, email marketing, campaign development, and nonprofit communications. Working under the supervision of the Communications Director, the Intern will help create engaging and accessible communications materials that elevate NMILC’s services, advocacy priorities, events, resources, and community-centered work.

The ideal candidate is a visual storyteller with a strong design eye; excellent attention to detail; interest in immigrant rights, public-interest law, advocacy, or nonprofit communications; and the ability to collaborate effectively while working independently in a semi-remote environment.

Primary Responsibilities

Creative Design and Content Development

  • Create engaging, accurate, and visually compelling content for NMILC’s social-media platforms, website, email marketing, reports, presentations, outreach materials, and digital campaigns.
  • Develop graphics, templates, layouts, infographics, digital toolkits, and other visual assets using NMILC’s brand standards and established style.
  • Support the development of accessible and audience-appropriate materials that communicate legal, policy, advocacy, and community information clearly.
  • Assist with formatting and preparing materials for digital distribution, presentations, internal use, and professional printing when needed.
  • Proofread and quality-check content for grammar, spelling, accurate links, layout consistency, visual quality, and alignment with NMILC’s voice and branding.
  • Organize and maintain digital files, design assets, photography, templates, and completed communications projects.

Social Media and Digital Campaigns

  • Assist with managing NMILC’s social-media presence across multiple platforms.
  • Create, schedule, and publish social-media posts and stories in coordination with the Communications Director and approved content calendars.
  • Help develop content calendars that support organizational priorities, advocacy campaigns, community education, events, fundraising, and client-resource promotion.
  • Identify opportunities to adapt and repurpose content across social media, email, web, print, and presentation formats.
  • Monitor social-media engagement and flag comments, direct messages, emerging opportunities, or concerns for the Communications Director.
  • Research digital-media trends, platform updates, best practices, and examples of effective nonprofit and advocacy communications.

Photography and Event Documentation

  • Assist with taking, selecting, editing, captioning, organizing, and archiving photographs for NMILC communications.
  • Help document community events, trainings, outreach activities, advocacy events, staff gatherings, and other organizational activities.
  • Follow NMILC procedures related to photography permissions, consent, confidentiality, privacy, and respectful representation of community members.
  • Support maintenance of photo releases, consent records, and organized image archives.

Website and Email Communications

  • Assist with updates to NMILC’s Squarespace website, including uploading and formatting content, refreshing pages, checking links, and making basic layout adjustments.
  • Support basic search-engine optimization and web-accessibility practices, including clear page titles, headings, links, image alt text, and readable content formatting.
  • Assist with quality assurance for website content by identifying outdated information, broken links, inconsistent formatting, or accessibility concerns.
  • Create graphics and visual materials for email marketing, newsletters, event notices, fundraising communications, and other digital outreach.

Reporting and Administrative Support

  • Assist with tracking social-media, website, email, and digital-campaign performance.
  • Help prepare concise reports or dashboards on audience engagement, content performance, campaign reach, and emerging trends.
  • Maintain project trackers, content calendars, asset libraries, and other communications records.
  • Participate in communications planning meetings, check-ins, trainings, and cross-functional collaboration as assigned.
  • Perform other related duties and special projects consistent with the purpose of the internship.

Required Qualifications

  • Interest in graphic design, digital media, communications, marketing, photography, advocacy, nonprofit work, public-interest law, or a related field.
  • Demonstrated ability to create visually appealing graphics or digital materials using Adobe Creative Suite, Canva, or similar design tools.
  • Familiarity with Adobe Photoshop, Illustrator, and InDesign is preferred; willingness and ability to learn is required.

raw.description:
Lumen is the trusted network for the AI‑powered world, connecting people, data, and applications through our expansive fiber network and connected ecosystem. We enable secure, high‑performance connectivity across cloud, edge, and AI workloads for enterprises, governments, and communities.

At Lumen, you’ll work on infrastructure customers rely on today and build for what’s next, where performance, security, and resilience matter.

This is a high accountability environment where bold ideas drive real innovation for our customers, partners, and industry. The work is challenging, expectations are clear, and trust is built into how we operate. If you’re ready to take ownership, deliver meaningful impact, and help shape the future of AI‑ready connectivity, join us today.

The Role

In a culture built on accountability, trust, and bold thinking, the Principal Architect, Cloud FinOps, plays a pivotal role in shaping the future of AI-ready connectivity. Working at the intersection of innovation and impact, this leader thrives in an environment where challenging work is embraced, expectations are clear, and meaningful contributions drive lasting value for customers, partners, and the industry.
As the enterprise’s technical authority for FinOps architecture, cloud economics, and financial governance, the Principal Architect leads the design of cost-aware cloud strategies across a complex multi-cloud ecosystem. By combining deep technical expertise with strategic business insight, this individual helps ensure that every cloud investment delivers measurable outcomes while supporting performance, scalability, resiliency, and security.
Partnering closely with Engineering, Enterprise Architecture, Finance, Cloud Platform teams, Strategic Sourcing, Product organizations, and Executive Leadership, the Principal Architect brings people and ideas together to solve complex challenges. Through collaboration and influence, they champion a shared vision of financial accountability and operational excellence across the cloud landscape.
Their impact extends beyond architecture design. By establishing enterprise standards, cloud consumption guardrails, unit economics frameworks, commitment optimization strategies, and migration blueprints, they create a foundation that empowers teams to innovate with confidence. Every decision is guided by a commitment to delivering business value, enabling sustainable growth, and helping the organization stay ahead in an increasingly connected, AI-driven world.

Location

This is a work from home position within the US.

The Main Responsibilities

• Enterprise Architecture

Define and govern multi-cloud architecture standards across Azure, AWS, and GCP. Develop reusable reference architectures, solution patterns, and governance frameworks. Lead architecture reviews for cloud transformation, modernization, and strategic initiatives while embedding financial accountability into design decisions.

• FinOps Leadership

Integrate cost optimization into architecture and engineering practices. Establish cost-aware patterns for compute, storage, networking, AI/ML, Kubernetes, databases, and SaaS platforms. Develop unit economics, chargeback/showback models, cloud costing methodologies, and enterprise FinOps maturity programs.

• Cloud Optimization

Lead application rationalization, cloud migration, and platform modernization efforts. Identify savings through rightsizing, scheduling, architectural improvements, consolidation, and commitment-based discounts. Implement financial guardrails, policy-as-code, and workload placement strategies that improve cost efficiency.

• Governance, Risk & Compliance

Define standards for cloud consumption, tagging, allocation, lifecycle management, and capacity planning. Ensure alignment with security, compliance, operational, and risk management requirements while participating in architecture and FinOps governance forums.

• Automation & Platform Enablement

Partner with engineering teams to automate cost controls, budget management, policy enforcement, optimization recommendations, and reporting. Support FinOps platforms, dashboards, operational tooling, and promote Infrastructure-as-Code (IaC) and FinOps-as-Code practices.

• Executive Leadership

Present architecture strategies, cloud economics recommendations, and optimization roadmaps to senior leadership. Develop business cases, ROI analyses, TCO assessments, and cloud investment strategies. Mentor architects, engineers, and FinOps practitioners while driving enterprise-wide cloud financial accountability.

What We Look For in a Candidate

  • 12+ years of enterprise architecture, cloud architecture, or technology strategy experience, 8+ years of public cloud experience across Azure, AWS, and/or Google Cloud Platform and 5+ years of FinOps, cloud economics, cloud governance, or cost optimization experience.
  • Proven experience influencing executive stakeholders and enterprise architecture decisions.

Technical Expertise

  • Enterprise architecture frameworks and governance and cloud economics, financial management. and FinOps operating models and unit economics and allocation methodologies.
  • Cloud migration strategies and kubernetes, container platforms, infrastructure-as-Code (Terraform, Bicep, CloudFormation) and cost management platforms (Flexera, CloudHealth, Apptio Cloudability, native CSP tooling) and AI/ML platform architecture and cost optimization.

Business Acumen

Financial modeling and forecasting, budget management, executive communications, business capability mapping.and strategic planning

Required Certifications

Candidates must possess at least one advanced FinOps certification and one major cloud architecture certification.

FinOps Certifications (Requred)

  • One or more of:
  • FinOps Certified Practitioner (FOCP) / FinOps Certified Engineer (FCE) / FinOps Certified Professional (FCP) / FinOps Certified Cloud Practitioner/ FinOps for Containers (FFC)
  • Cloud Architecture Certifications (Required)
  • One or more of:
  • AWS Certified Solutions Architect – Professional
  • Microsoft Azure Solutions Architect Expert
  • Google Professional Cloud Architect

Preferred Certifications

  • TOGAF 9/10, Certified Kubernetes Administrator (CKA), Certified Kubernetes Application Developer (CKAD), AWS DevOps Engineer Professional, Azure DevOps Engineer Expert

Head of Growth - Performance Media Buyer & Creative Strategist (eCommerce)

Full-time · Fully remote · Possible equity upside for strong performance

About us

We are Folqs, a fast-growing D2C supplement brand in the United States focused on colostrum + beef organs.

We're looking for a Head of Growth aka killer performance media buyer/creative strategist who is already operating at a high level in eCommerce. This isn't a role for someone who wants to learn how to scale an eCommerce brand. We want someone who has already done it.

Our goal is simple: bring in someone who can jump in, take ownership of our growth engine, and take Folqs to the next level.

What you'll own

  • Paid media: Own and scale Meta as the primary acquisition channel, with additional experience across Google and/or TikTok Paid
  • Creative strategy: Identify winning customer angles, hooks, messaging, formats, and concepts based on performance data and customer research
  • Creative testing: Build and manage a systematic testing pipeline and rapidly identify winning creatives
  • Full-funnel performance: Analyze and optimize the entire journey from ad advertorial/landing page offer conversion
  • Research: Mine customer reviews, surveys, Reddit, competitor ads, Meta Ads Library, and other sources for new angles and opportunities
  • Creative production: Brief and manage UGC creators, editors, and designers - while remaining hands-on with scripts, hooks, copy, and creative direction
  • Performance analysis: Make daily decisions around what to scale, iterate, or kill based on CPA, ROAS, CTR, hook rate, thumbstop rate, CVR, contribution margin, and other relevant metrics
  • Scaling: Take proven creative and media-buying strategies and turn them into significant increases in profitable spend
  • Funnels: Work on advertorials, landing pages, VSLs, offers, and other conversion assets to improve overall acquisition efficiency
  • AI: Use AI aggressively to accelerate research, creative ideation, scripting, production, analysis, and workflows

What success looks like

We don't measure activity; we measure results. This is a 100% performance role focused on scaling spend while maintaining CAC ceiling.

Success means:

  • Scaling paid spend while maintaining healthy unit economics
  • Improving ROAS and reducing CPA
  • Increasing creative win rate and testing velocity
  • Finding new winning angles and audiences
  • Improving conversion rates across the funnel
  • Building a repeatable creative and media-buying system
  • Ultimately, taking Folqs to the next level

You are

  • 4–6+ years of experience creating performance creatives for D2C/eCommerce brands or eCommerce agencies (not B2B, not a generalist)
  • A proven Meta media buyer who has personally scaled campaigns, not just overseen them (at least $50k/month in ad spend)
  • Equally strong on creative strategy and performance marketing
  • Deeply experienced with direct-response advertising and customer psychology
  • Able to look at an ad account, creative performance, and funnel data and immediately identify what needs to change
  • Experienced scaling DTC/eCommerce brands - not B2B, SaaS, lead generation, or general marketing
  • Hands-on with creative: you can write or heavily edit hooks, scripts, headlines, briefs, and landing page copy
  • Experienced managing creative production with UGC creators, editors, and designers
  • An operator, not a consultant. You don't just make recommendations - you execute, test, learn, and scale
  • Comfortable working directly with founders and taking significant ownership with minimal hand-holding
  • AI-native: you use AI daily to accelerate research, creative development, analysis, and execution
  • Fast-moving, highly analytical, and obsessed with finding what works

Strong bonus points

  • Experience scaling supplements, health, wellness, beauty, or other DTC consumer brands
  • Experience with advertorials, VSLs, or aggressive direct-response funnels
  • Experience with TikTok Paid / Spark Ads
  • Experience with Outbrain or Taboola
  • Experience with tools such as Triple Whale, Northbeam, Motion, Foreplay, or similar
  • Strong understanding of FTC/FDA considerations for supplement advertising

Important: Who this role is NOT for

This is not a fit if:

  • You've managed less than $50K/month in ad spend
  • Your background is primarily organic social or influencer marketing
  • You're primarily a creative strategist who doesn't understand media buying
  • You're primarily a media buyer who relies on someone else for all creative strategy
  • You've worked mainly in B2B, SaaS, lead generation, or non-eCommerce environments
  • You're looking for a role where someone else tells you what to do

We want someone who can walk into an eCommerce brand, look at the numbers and the creative, figure out what's broken, and start making it better immediately.

Schedule

  • Fully remote
  • Full-time
  • Minimum 6-hour overlap with US Eastern Time (10:00 AM–4:00 PM ET)
  • Direct collaboration with the founders
  • Significant ownership and autonomy
  • Possible equity upside for strong performance

We are diverse in many ways, yet our values unite us. Our values are how we work, not words on a wall. If they sound like you, you will feel at home here.

  • Integrity and trust: we do the right thing, especially when it is hard.

That work takes curious minds, problem-solvers and experts who care about getting it right. It also takes a culture worth staying for. Across Europe, North America, South America, Asia and Australia, we work in an environment built on kindness, flexibility, growth and belonging, where colleagues support one another and good ideas are heard wherever they come from.

raw.description:
About NOCD

NOCD is the #1 telehealth provider for the treatment of obsessive-compulsive disorder (OCD). OCD is one of the most severe, prevalent, and misunderstood mental health conditions. NOCD creates access to online therapy for people with OCD through our telehealth platform. In the NOCD app, Members can quickly access and schedule live, face-to-face video therapy sessions with our national network of licensed Therapists that specialize in Exposure and Response Prevention Therapy (ERP) - considered the "gold standard" in OCD treatment.

At NOCD, we help people reclaim their lives with clinically proven OCD treatment, by removing barriers to OCD care, and reducing the stigma associated with OCD. We’re changing the world and need other like-minded individuals to accelerate and expand our efforts.

About The Role

As the specialist virtual behavioral health provider, NOCD, wants our Therapists to focus on what's most important – treating and caring for our members.

NOCD is looking for Independently Licensed Therapists (LP, LMFT, LPC, LCSW) in Wisconsin to join our network.
We will provide the training necessary to become a specialized therapist and ensure you are fully equipped to deliver effective, evidence-based treatment.

As a NOCD Therapist, you will see our team is committed to achieving clinical excellence, an exquisite Therapist experience and providing proven & visible clinical outcomes. We have dedicated teams to handle marketing, billing, credentialing, and scheduling. Therapists will use valuable previous clinical experience, good judgment, and our clinical guidelines to discern when to refer members to external resources. Providers will collaborate with our network of psychiatrists and therapists to help develop and reinforce treatment decisions.

You'll enjoy growth and support through: ongoing consultation with other team members; specialized clinical training with experienced OCD providers; information on the latest research advancements in the field; technical support and clinical protocols; 1:1 mentorship to discuss complex cases; and an open, receptive environment to provide feedback.

What You'll Do

  • Help people with OCD get better and stay better by providing top-notch care through diagnoses, assessments, and evidence-based psychotherapy via the NOCD video platform
  • Manage your caseload and schedule
  • Maintain complete and timely clinical documentation using the NOCD EHR system
  • Participate in NOCD clinical consultation, training, and advance your knowledge and practice of evidence-supported treatments for OCD
  • Collaborate with our network of providers to help develop and reinforce treatment decisions

Requirements

  • See credentialing information here.
  • Full Time Providers:
    • 40 hour work week
    • Complete 25 hours of direct clinical work per week
    • Attend a world-class training program developed by industry leaders
    • Attend 2 hours of weekly group clinical consultation
    • Have 10 hours of weeknight/weekend availability after 5pm local time for Member Sessions
    • Will participate in and complete cross-license application process during Onboarding
    • Open and willing to treat children and adolescents after attending NOCD Child and Adolescent training
  • Practical experience independently diagnosing is required for this role (this practical experience can be during your pre-licensed experience).
    • If you do not have this direct practical experience, proof of completion (with certificate) of the following training will be accepted in its place: Tolin & Diamond Training Video.
    • Please note: submission of proof of completion does not guarantee hire, NOCD will not reimburse the cost of this course.

Who You Are

  • Full and unrestricted license in good standing to practice in your state.
    • Masters Degree Required
    • Wisconsin: Licensed Psychologist, Licensed Marriage and Family Therapist, Licensed Professional Counselor, Licensed Clinical Social Worker
  • At least 6 months of relevant experience with evidence-based therapies (e.g., ERP, CBT, ACT) preferred
  • Knowledge and experience with treating OCD with ERP is preferable but not required
  • Organized, quick and enthusiastic learner, excellent communicator, good with time management
  • Have a confidential, private location to work remotely from with reliable internet access
  • Comfortable and efficient with using technology to communicate
  • Ambitious and ready to keep up with a goal-driven, start-up environment

What We Offer

  • A commitment to clinical excellence, an exquisite Therapist experience and proven & visible clinical outcomes.
  • Gain world-class training from experienced OCD providers to become a specialized Therapist in treating OCD and related disorders through evidence-based care.
  • A full suite of support through continued mentorship & feedback
  • Investment in new technology built to improve the NOCD Therapist experience and allow our Therapists to continue to focus on Member care.
  • Competitive compensation with a robust bonus program
  • Comprehensive benefits package, including medical, dental, vision coverage, 401(k) match, and paid parental leave for eligible employees
  • PTO based on an accrual system
  • Casual and engaging startup environment with an outstanding mission-driven team atmosphere
  • Specialized ERP training with experienced OCD providers
  • Work remotely from the comfort of your own home or office
  • Centralized scheduling
  • An investment in your personal growth through a clear career path
  • Access to NOCD Professional Development Trainings and ongoing consultation with other team members

Job Title: Full-Stack Data Engineer

Job Location: Zapopan, Jalisco, Mexico

Job Location Type: Remote

Job Contract Type: Full-time

Job Seniority Level:

We are looking for a passionate Full Stack Data Engineer who will help strengthen our data engineering capability with modern software engineering practices. This individual will build robust, maintainable, and scalable data solutions across the data lifecycle, while also contributing to the team’s wider engineering standards, tooling, and ways of working.

This is a hands-on engineering role for someone who is equally comfortable developing data pipelines, Python services, and automation for deployment and operations, and who can partner effectively with architects, analysts, product teams, and other engineers to deliver reliable data products.

Roles & Responsibilities

  • Design, build, and support scalable data pipelines, data products, and data applications that serve business and analytics needs.

  • Apply software engineering best practices to data engineering, including modular design, version control, code review, automated testing, documentation, and maintainable architecture.

  • Develop Python-based solutions for data processing, orchestration, integration, automation, and supporting application components where required.

  • Own and improve DevOps/DataOps practices for data solutions, including CI/CD, environment promotion, release automation, observability, incident response, and production support.

  • Deliver robust, cost-effective, and automated solutions to address recurring business questions and analytical demands.

  • Design and implement data solutions aligned with enterprise standards, architecture roadmaps, and platform best practices, working closely with Data Architects and Solution Architects.

  • Test and quality assure data and analytics solutions to ensure they are fit for release, including code assurance, unit testing, integration testing, data validation, performance tuning, and release management.

  • Support operational excellence through proactive monitoring, root-cause analysis, issue resolution, and continuous improvement of SLAs and service reliability.

  • Promote engineering consistency across the team by disseminating best practices, coaching peers, contributing reusable patterns, and helping improve standards, tooling, and ways of working.

  • Evaluate and adopt new technologies relevant to data engineering, software engineering, and platform automation, including proof-of-value assessments and contribution to business cases.

  • Contribute to estimates, delivery planning, and solution design for new data initiatives and enhancements.

  • Ensure business data assets are delivered as trusted, discoverable, and reusable data products/services for broader enterprise consumption, in alignment with strategic data principles.

  • Collaborate with stakeholders to translate business requirements into reliable technical solutions, define acceptance criteria, and establish appropriate operational and service expectations.

  • Maintain ongoing professional development in modern data, cloud, and engineering practices to help keep AstraZeneca current with a changing technology landscape.

Mandatory Skills

  • Strong software engineering background, with hands-on experience building production-grade solutions using sound engineering principles such as modular design, testing, code review, and maintainability.

  • Strong Python engineering skills, including building reusable packages, APIs, automation scripts, data processing components, and integration services.

  • Hands-on experience designing and operating solutions in Snowflake, including virtual warehouse configuration, resource monitors, governance, and performance tuning.

  • Expert SQL for analytics and transformation, with strong skills in query optimization, pruning, caching behavior, and result set reuse.

  • Experience building robust pipelines into Snowflake with tools such as dbt, Airflow, dataops.live, Fivetran, AWS Glue, or AWS Lambda, with strong understanding of staging patterns, incremental loads, CDC, retries, error handling, and observability.

  • Practical experience with data modeling, including dimensional and normalized approaches, and strong understanding of schema design, standardization, clustering keys, micro-partitioning, and workload/performance strategies.

  • Experience with dbt modeling layers, materializations, testing, project configuration, documentation standards, and data contracts.

  • Experience implementing automated testing and quality controls for data solutions, including unit, integration, and data validation testing.

  • Strong experience with CI/CD pipelines, Git-based workflows, and deployment automation for data and application components.

  • Experience with DevOps/DataOps practices, including environment management, release management, infrastructure automation, monitoring, and production support.

  • Experience integrating Python-based data engineering solutions with serverless and cloud-native services, such as AWS Lambda and AWS Glue.

  • Demonstrated track record delivering solutions on modern data platforms such as Snowflake or Redshift, and integrating them with downstream analytics or visualization tools.

  • Strong analytical and problem-solving skills, including diagnosing and resolving production issues in complex data environments.

  • Ability to translate business requirements into reliable technical solutions and data products with clear ownership, SLAs, and acceptance criteria.

  • Strong understanding of FAIR data principles and data product best practices, including discoverability, metadata, lineage, interoperability, access controls, versioning, and consumer-oriented design.

  • Effective working independently and within cross-functional, cross-cultural teams, with the ability to communicate technical concepts clearly to non-technical stakeholders.

  • Demonstrable passion for learning and for improving engineering practices across a team.

Desired Skills

  • Experience using Starburst/Trino for distributed SQL across heterogeneous data sources.

  • Familiarity with Terraform, GitHub Actions, and highly automated platform or pipeline delivery patterns.

  • Experience with infrastructure as code and environment provisioning in cloud-based data platforms.

  • Familiarity with metadata and catalog tooling such as Collibra to improve lineage, standards adoption, reuse, and observability.

  • Experience using PySpark for large-scale data processing and transformation in distributed environments.

  • Experience building lightweight application or service layers that complement data pipelines, such as APIs, internal tools, or operational utilities.

  • Experience mentoring peers and helping establish engineering standards across a team or community of practice.

Summary

The Full Stack Data Engineer is responsible for the design, development, deployment, and operational support of scalable data products and data applications in a DevOps/DataOps delivery model. This role combines strong data engineering expertise with a solid software engineering background, especially in Python, cloud-native development, and engineering automation.

The role is expected not only to build reliable data solutions, but also to raise engineering maturity across the team by disseminating best practices in software design, testing, CI/CD, observability, reuse, and operational excellence.

This product is a critical backbone of the commerce ecosystem—largely invisible to end users, but essential to speed, scale, and policy compliance for customer travel programs. As the Sr. Product Manager you will be part of a team with the other Product Manager, to help guide, coach and mentor and show leadership for the product. You will also be part of the Leadership Team for Agent Technology.

As a Sr. Product Manager, Travel Commerce Admin, you will

  • Translate commerce platform needs into scalable admin and configuration capabilities
  • Deeply understand configuration workflows, pain points, and scalability constraints
  • Ensure admin tools reduce manual effort, errors, and dependency on engineering teams
  • Provide management of PNR formats globally
  • Identify opportunities for innovation and improvement
  • Contribute to the vision, strategy, and roadmap for the Admin & Configuration Platform
  • Product Management of 3rd party tools used for Travel Commerce Platform
  • Work closely with Travel Commerce Product Managers to ensure admin capabilities support go-to-market needs
  • Act as the voice of internal users: implementations, support, product teams (hotel, car, air, rail, payment) and other product areas (ie. Core services)
  • Partner closely with engineering, UX, and architecture to deliver high-quality solutions
  • Partner with Implementation and Operations teams to streamline onboarding and configuration at scale

About you

  • Comfortable operating between strategy and detailed execution
  • Data-informed, systems-oriented thinker
  • Strong product discovery and problem framing skills (internal user focus)
  • Ability to translate complex business/platform needs into clear requirements and user stories
  • Comfortable working with APIs, data models, and configuration concepts (not required to code)
  • Analytical and metrics-driven; able to define KPIs and use data to drive prioritization
  • Strong stakeholder management and communication (clear written updates, structured decision-making)
  • Execution mindset with attention to detail, quality, and operational impact
  • Experience in product management, preferably platform or internal products
  • Experience working in complex, multi-market, multi-client environments

What we offer you

At BCD Travel, we work with highly motivated and passionate people. We value open communication, collaboration, and a flexible work-life balance. We offer unique, often global, experiences that empower you to develop and grow within the organization. Sustainability and helping others is also high on our list. We make a difference through charitable activities in our communities across the globe.

About us

BCD Travel helps companies travel smart and achieve more. We drive program adoption, cost savings and talent retention through digital experiences that simplify business travel. Our 15,000+ dedicated team members service clients in 170+ countries as we shape a sustainable future for business travel. BCD’s leading meetings and events management and global consultancy services complete our comprehensive suite of solutions for all aspects of corporate travel. In 2024, BCD achieved US$22.9 billion in sales. For more information, visit www.bcdtravel.com.

Get to know us by reading our blog and checking out our social media:

You’ll be offered

  • Flexible working hours and work-from-home or remote opportunities
  • Opportunities to grow your skillset and career
  • Generous vacation days so you can rest and recharge
  • A compensation package that feels fair to you, including mental, physical, and financial wellbeing tools
  • Travel industry professional perks and discounts
  • An inclusive work environment where diversity is celebrated

At BCD Travel we value you, our culture and success is defined by you. We carefully consider a wide range of compensation factors, including your professional background and experience. The salary range for candidates in applicable jurisdictions in the US for the position of Sr. Product Manager, Travel Commerce Admin is between $100,000 and $127,000. The actual pay depends on your skills, qualifications, experience and geographical location.

Ready to join the journey? Apply now!

About Us

HireHawk connects skilled professionals worldwide with meaningful opportunities at U.S. and Canadian companies. We build high-performing remote teams across Latin America, the Philippines, South Africa, Europe, and beyond, with a culture centered on ownership, clear expectations, and measurable outcomes.

About the Role

As Executive Assistant to the CEO, you will help organize and advance priorities across multiple companies, teams, and new ventures. This is a broad executive operations role, not a position limited to calendar and inbox management. You will coordinate people, projects, hiring initiatives, research, and follow-ups while stepping into operational gaps when something needs immediate attention. You will have significant autonomy, direct access to decision-making, and the opportunity to become a trusted partner to the CEO.

This is a full-time remote position working Monday through Friday during U.S. business hours. Priorities may shift quickly, so success requires strong judgment, calm execution, and the ability to turn loosely defined requests into clear next steps.

Responsibilities

  • Turn the CEO’s priorities into clear action plans, owners, deadlines, and follow-up steps across multiple businesses.
  • Keep important projects moving by identifying blockers, coordinating stakeholders, and ensuring commitments are completed.
  • Build and maintain reliable systems for tracking projects, decisions, deadlines, open questions, and executive follow-ups.
  • Move hiring priorities forward by coordinating job postings, sourcing, screening, interviews, candidate communication, and onboarding activities.
  • Translate ideas and verbal requests into organized briefs, documents, workflows, and assignments that teams can execute.
  • Create alignment between the CEO and teams across operations, finance, marketing, sales, recruiting, e-commerce, and other functions.
  • Anticipate operational needs, surface risks early, and resolve routine issues before they require the CEO’s involvement.
  • Prepare the CEO for meetings and decisions by organizing relevant context, documents, updates, and outstanding questions.
  • Coordinate executive logistics, including scheduling, travel, reservations, communications, and time-sensitive requests when needed.

Requirements

Must-Have:

  • At least 3 years of experience in executive assistance, executive operations, project coordination, operations support, or a similar role.
  • Experience working directly with a CEO, founder, entrepreneur, or senior business leader.
  • Strong project ownership, including the ability to track multiple priorities and follow through without repeated reminders.
  • Excellent written and verbal English communication skills.
  • Proven ability to research unfamiliar topics, evaluate options, and present information clearly.
  • Sound judgment, discretion, and professionalism when handling sensitive business and personnel matters.
  • Confidence using Google Workspace, Slack, spreadsheets, project management platforms, and modern AI or productivity tools.

Nice to Have:

  • Experience supporting an executive responsible for multiple businesses, departments, or complex initiatives.
  • Experience supporting distributed teams working across countries or time zones.
  • Familiarity with e-commerce, professional services, staffing, marketing, or other multi-functional businesses.
  • Experience improving internal processes, trackers, documentation, or executive operating systems.
  • A globally distributed work environment that values initiative, reliable follow-through, and outcomes over unnecessary activity.

Um dos maiores grupos de beleza do mundo, o Grupo Boticário é uma empresa brasileira presente em mais de 40 países. É dono das marcas O Boticário, Eudora, Quem Disse, Berenice?, Vult, O.U.i, Dr. JONES, Tô.que.tô, TRUSS, e do marketplace Beleza na Web, além de atuar com produtos licenciados como Australian Gold, Bio Oil, Nuxe, e Pampers e sua divisão para o mercado B2B. Essa interação entre diferentes marcas, ativos, plataformas, rede de franqueados, representantes, distribuidores, varejistas, sellers e fornecedores formam o ecossistema de beleza do Grupo Boticário que oferece, ainda, soluções digitais de gestão de negócio para o varejo brasileiro por meio das suas marcas Mooz e GAVB. São mais de 19 mil colaboradores diretos, com mais de 4 mil lojas em 1.780 cidades brasileiras.

Vem fazer beleza com a gente!

Descrição do escopo:

  • Atuará no atendimento e primeiras tratativas dos chamados de sustentação do e-commerce do Grupo Boticário. Esses chamados podem vir da área comercial, operações, tech ou de alertas automatizados.
  • Responsável pelas rotinas de monitoramento das APIs, comunicação com stakeholders e atualização das descrições e status no Business Map / Service Now.
  • Fará a investigação dos incidentes nos logs, relatórios e ferramentas do grupo, buscando a solução mais rápida para o problema sempre que tiver atuação, garantindo um melhor SLA.
  • Em caso de não atuação, encaminhará o incidente para a squad responsável (N3), fazendo a tratativa com o requisitante do chamado e a devida atualização de status e descrição no Business Map / ServiceNow.
  • Apoiará na coleta e apresentação de métricas com informações dos incidentes e chamados.

Requisito técnico: (Obrigatório):

  • Perfil analítico para elaborar análises, identificar erros e análise de logs.
  • Fundamentos de Itil e Agilidade.
  • Experiência com soluções e sustentação envolvendo plataformas de software e integrações.
  • Experiência em plataforma E-commerce.

Diferencial técnico: (Opcional).

  • Experiência com gestão de problemas.
  • Conhecimento em ferramentas de monitoramento de logs e aplicações.
  • Experiência em banco de dados SQL e NoSQL.
  • Conceito de execução de protocolos HTTP.
  • Conhecimento de micro serviços.
  • Conceito de Rest APIs.

Requisito comportamentais:

  • Bom relacionamento em equipe.
  • Boa comunicação.
  • Ser dinâmico e auto gerenciável para o atendimento de diferentes áreas do ecommerce.
  • Vontade de aprender. Existe muito espaço para novos aprendizados e muitas oportunidades, portanto esse é um requisito fundamental para o seu sucesso.
  • Experiência com atendimento ao cliente (interno ou externo).
  • Capacidade de analisar problemas e consolidar as informações para identificação de causa raiz.
  • Proatividade em inovações, buscando melhorar processos internos. .

No Grupo Boticário, o cuidado é a nossa base para atingirmos resultados exponenciais. Temos um portfólio com mais de 20 benefícios para cuidar da sua saúde, bem estar e família. Confira abaixo.

Seguridade para proteção e tranquilidade financeira

Du analysierst Ursachen, koordinierst Lösungswege gemeinsam mit Fachbereichen und trägst aktiv dazu bei, unsere Servicequalität kontinuierlich weiterzuentwickeln. Was du bewirkst

  • Analysierst und bearbeitest komplexe sowie eskalierte Supportanfragen eigenständig und entwickelst nachhaltige Lösungen für unsere Kundinnen

  • Übernimmst Tickets aus dem 1st Level Support, priorisierst diese zielgerichtet und stellst eine effiziente Bearbeitung sicher

  • Analysierst technische Herausforderungen in Client Server Umgebungen, Datenbanken und Schnittstellen und leitest passende Maßnahmen ab

  • Arbeitest eng mit Entwicklung, Produktmanagement und weiteren Fachbereichen zusammen, um Fehlerursachen nachhaltig zu beseitigen und Produkte kontinuierlich zu verbessern

  • Dokumentierst Lösungen und Best Practices zur Sicherung und Weitergabe von Wissen im Team

  • Bringst Ideen zur Optimierung von Servicequalität, Prozessen und eingesetzten Tools aktiv ein

Was du mitbringst

  • Verfügst über mehrjährige Erfahrung im technischen Software Support, idealerweise im 2nd Level Support oder einer vergleichbaren Rolle

  • Hast eine abgeschlossene IT Ausbildung, beispielsweise als Fachinformatiker für Systemintegration, oder ein Studium der Informatik, Wirtschaftsinformatik beziehungsweise eines vergleichbaren Fachgebiets mit entsprechender Berufserfahrung

  • Bringst ein fundiertes Verständnis von Windows Umgebungen, Remote Support, Client Server Architekturen sowie grundlegenden Netzwerk und Datenbankthemen mit

  • Hast Erfahrung im Umgang mit Ticketsystemen, Service Tools und Wissensdatenbanken

  • Kommunizierst technische Sachverhalte verständlich und adressatengerecht

Ein Plus, aber kein Muss

  • Verfügst über Erfahrung mit Microsoft SQL Server oder vergleichbaren Datenbanksystemen

  • Bringst Kenntnisse im Gesundheitswesen oder im Umfeld von Softwarelösungen für Pflege, Therapie oder soziale Einrichtungen mit

  • Hast Erfahrung in der Analyse wiederkehrender Fehlerbilder und der Optimierung von Supportprozessen

Das zeichnet dich aus

  • Lösungsorientierung Du gehst Ursachen strukturiert auf den Grund und entwickelst nachhaltige Lösungsansätze

  • Analytisches Denken Du erkennst Zusammenhänge schnell und leitest fundierte Maßnahmen ab

  • Teamorientierung Du arbeitest bereichsübergreifend zusammen und teilst dein Wissen aktiv

  • Qualitätsbewusstsein Du hinterfragst bestehende Abläufe und bringst Verbesserungen gezielt voran

Unsere Benefits für dich

  • Du entscheidest: Hansefit, EGYM Wellpass, Kinderbetreuung oder JobRad – wir unterstützen Dich flexibel mit einem Zuschuss von bis zu 60 € monatlich. Zusätzlich profitierst Du von exklusiven Vergünstigungen mit Corporate Benefits

  • Du kannst auf uns zählen – TELUS Health stärkt Dich mit individuellen Angeboten für Deine mentale Gesundheit

  • Wir gestalten Deine Entwicklung – mit LinkedIn Learning hast Du Zugriff auf inspirierende Lerninhalte und praxisnahe Weiterbildung, die Dich wirklich voranbringen

  • Wir denken an Deine Zukunft – mit unserem Aktienkaufprogramm kannst Du direkt am Unternehmenserfolg teilhaben, und durch unsere betriebliche Altersvorsorge (bAV) sicherst Du Dir finanzielle Stabilität für die Zukunft

  • Du hast 30 Tage Urlaubsanspruch, um ausreichend Zeit für Erholung und persönliche Interessen zu haben

Die MEDIFOX DAN Gruppe mit Hauptsitz in Hildesheim gehört zur Resmed Corp. und beschäftigt über 900 Mitarbeitende an neun Standorten. Wir setzen auf Teamgeist, Kundenorientierung und Leidenschaft und arbeiten an zukunftsweisenden Softwarelösungen im Gesundheits und Sozialwesen, um Innovationen voranzutreiben. Seit über 30 Jahren revolutionieren wir die Pflegebranche und suchen Menschen, die eine Leidenschaft für Technik in einer starken Unternehmenskultur teilen.

JOB SUMMARY

The Finance Technology Product & Portfolio Lead is responsible for establishing, leading, and continuously evolving the centralized Finance Technology Demand and Portfolio Management function. This role serves as the primary bridge between Finance stakeholders and Technology teams, ensuring business initiatives are appropriately evaluated, prioritized, funded, governed, and delivered.

The incumbent will own the end-to-end demand lifecycle from intake through value realization, enabling a transparent, data-driven approach to investment decisions, resource allocation, portfolio governance, and strategic execution. This role will also drive product strategy and roadmap development for assigned Finance technology capabilities while ensuring alignment to Finance transformation objectives, operational priorities, regulatory requirements, and enterprise strategy.

  • Act as a primary liaison between Finance business stakeholders and technology teams, translating business needs into technical requirements and vice versa.

raw.description:
About Us:

STACK is a leading provider of cloud-based construction estimating and takeoff software solutions, committed to helping businesses transform through innovative solutions. We pride ourselves on fostering a collaborative, dynamic environment where team members have the opportunity to grow and make a real impact.

About the Role:

We are hiring aSenior Computer Vision Engineerto improve our computer vision system for construction documents. This role focuses on detection and segmentation quality, geometric accuracy, and production-grade pipelines that work reliably with messy real-world PDFs and drawings.

What You’ll Do:

  • Design, build, and improve end-to-end detection and segmentation pipelines for document images.
  • Improve document ingestion for PDFs and other unstructured files, including parsing, rendering, and handling of multi-page and multi-view content.
  • Increase model accuracy, boundary and geometric quality, and overall reliability of predictions for downstream use.
  • Integrate modern detection and segmentation models into production workflows and build the post-processing that turns model output into structured, usable geometry.
  • Define evaluation metrics, investigate failure cases, and drive continuous quality improvements.
  • Optimize latency, reliability, and cost across the inference and post-processing stack.
  • Own training infrastructure, dataset curation, annotation quality, and continuous-improvement loops.
  • Make architectural decisions and own system quality end to end.

What You Bring:

  • 5+ years experience building computer vision systems: detection, segmentation, or structured geometry extraction, used high volume in production.
  • Experience working with messy, real-world image data or large unstructured visual datasets.
  • Strong understanding of detection and segmentation tradeoffs, including model architecture choices, training data design, and post-processing.
  • Ability to measure system performance with evaluation, testing, and production metrics.
  • Ability to explain failure modes clearly and improve systems through debugging, dataset work, and iteration.
  • Experience with multimodal models (vision-language models, document AI systems)
  • Understanding of grounding — linking model outputs to source data or coordinates
  • Backend engineering experience, including APIs, async processing, and scalable GPU services.

Additional Preferred Qualifications:

  • Experience with polygon or mask post-processing, geometric regularization, or CAD-style structured output.
  • Experience with layout-aware document processing, PDF vector extraction, or combining raster and vector signals.
  • Background in document-heavy CV domains such as construction, real estate, medical imaging, geospatial, or similar workflows.
  • Experience optimizing inference cost and latency at scale.
  • Familiarity with open-source detection / segmentation ecosystems, training infrastructure, or model serving.

What Success Looks Like:

  • Accurate, geometrically correct predictions suitable for downstream measurement, and analysis use.
  • Fast, reliable inference across large and messy real-world document sets.
  • Clear quality metrics and a repeatable improvement loop.
  • Systems that perform consistently under real-world production constraints.

What This Role is Not:

  • Not a model-training-only role. You'll own data, training, post-processing, and serving.
  • Not a research-only role.
  • Not a plug-and-play CV tools environment.

Why Join STACK?

  • Opportunity to work in a fast-paced, growth-oriented, remote-first environment.
  • Async-friendly environment with a focus on ownership and deep work.
  • Be part of a dynamic, supportive team where your contributions are valued.

At STACK, our values shape how we work, collaborate, and serve our customers:

  • Radical Honesty:Communicate directly, respectfully, and transparently—even when conversations are difficult. Give and receive feedback with care.
  • Customer Obsession:Put the customer at the center of every decision. Solve real problems, follow through, and measure success by customer outcomes.
  • Move With Purpose:Take thoughtful action, remain accountable, and own both successes and mistakes. Anticipate what’s next and adapt as you learn.
  • Grow Together:Share knowledge, collaborate across teams, and invest in one another’s development. Celebrate collective wins and treat setbacks as opportunities to learn.

We are an equal opportunity employer and value diversity at our company. We do not discriminate on the basis of race, religion, color, national origin, gender, sexual orientation, age, marital status, veteran status, or disability status. We are committed to building a team that represents a variety of backgrounds, perspectives, and skills. The more inclusive we are, the better our work will be.

We are interested in every qualified candidate who is eligible to work in the United Kingdom. However, we are not able to sponsor visas.

We take into account an individual’s qualifications, skillset, and experience in determining final salary. This role is eligible for health insurance (medical, dental & vision), life insurance, 401(k) & paid time off. The actual offer will be at the company’s sole discretion and determined by relevant business considerations, including the final candidate’s qualifications, years of experience, skillset, and geographic location.
